title: Customer Service Representative English
description:
You will support the Customer Service team with tasks such as order entry, stock assignment, requests of certificates, etc.

 As you will progress in your training, the responsibilities can be expanded to direct customer support and coordination of the full order to cash process for a selected amount of customers.

  • Act as a key point of contact for assigned customers and provide professional and timely support.
  • Manage the end-to-end order process, including order entry, verification, delivery coordination and invoicing.
  • Maintain accurate customer and order information in the systems.
  • Provide customers and Sales colleagues with clear updates on order and delivery status.
  • Prepare relevant documentation, including order confirmations, delivery documents and certificates.
  • Respond to customer inquiries and help resolve order, delivery, pricing or product-related questions.
  • Register and follow up on customer complaints, returns and other order-related issues.
  • Work closely with Sales and internal stakeholders to ensure an efficient customer experience.
  • Collaborate with colleagues across Customer Service, Supply Chain, Sales, Quality and other departments.

 

  • You have experience in Customer Service, Sales Support, Order Management, Administration or a similar environment. 
  • You are customer-focused, organized and comfortable managing different priorities and administrative tasks.
  • You communicate clearly and enjoy working with customers and colleagues from different countries and cultures.
  • You are confident working with Microsoft Excel, Outlook and Teams.
  • Experience with SAP or another ERP system is considered a strong advantage.
  • You are fluent in English, both spoken and written.
  • Knowledge of Russian is an additional asset, but is not required.
  • You work accurately, take ownership and enjoy contributing to a collaborative team environment.

title: Site Acquisition Specialist
description:
Functie

Wij zijn op zoek naar een zeer gemotiveerde Site Acquisition Specialist, gevestigd in België, voor het identificeren, leiden en sluiten van investeringsmogelijkheden op de Belgische markt met de focus op Brussel en Vlaanderen.

Dit is een kans om deel uit te maken van een team dat momenteel op weg is om zich te vestigen als een van de marktleiders in Europa.

Taken:

  • Het verwerven en beheren van investeringsopportuniteiten vanaf het eerste contact met de verkoper via onderhandelingen tot closing.
  • Eigenaarschap en onafhankelijkheid nemen in het beheren van een pijplijn.
  • Analyse van de aantrekkelijkheid van mobiele zendmastlocaties en de bijbehorende aankoopcontracten met mobiele telefoonaanbieders providers.
  • Eigen ideeën inbrengen om het proces en de resultaten te verbeteren.
Profiel

Wie zoeken wij?

  • Ervaring en affiniteit met vastgoed, syndicus en/of telecommunicatie.
  • Onderhandelingservaring en passende ervaring in de omgang met huidige of potentiële klanten is een vereiste.
  • Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en een sterke teamgeest. Iemand die sociaal is en een sterk empathisch vermogen. Je hebt gedegen mensenkennis.
  • Kan zeer goed autonoom werken, is direct operationeel en is bereid om bij te leren.
  • Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands & Frans.
  • Aantoonbare vaardigheid om resultaten te behalen en effectief prioriteiten te stellen in een snelle, dynamische omgeving omgeving is een must.
Wat je van ons krijgt

Aanbod:

  • Als Site Acquisition Specialist kun je rekenen op een competitief salaris en een commissie systeem.
  • Werken in eigen regio.
  • Geen vaste uren, grote mate van onafhankelijkheid en flexibiliteit.
  • Een dynamisch, groeigericht team en de mogelijkheid om je eigen ideeën te implementeren in een toonaangevend bedrijf met stabiele financiering.
  • Bedrijfswagen + Tankkaart
  • Laptop & GSM
.

title: Senior Accountant in Brussels - International company
description:
Our client is a leading international trading and supply chain organization with a long-established presence across Europe and a strong global footprint. Active in the distribution and trading of industrial and chemical products, the company combines commercial expertise, logistics capabilities, and financial strength to support international business operations.


Jobomschrijving

As Senior Accountant, you will play a key role in ensuring the accuracy of accounting operations, compliance, and financial reporting within an international business environment. Working closely with a Shared Service Center and stakeholders across Europe, your responsibilities will include:

  • Managing monthly, quarterly, and annual closing activities, including accruals, reconciliations, and balance sheet reviews;
  • Acting as the accounting reference point for the Belgian entity and overseeing the quality of accounting transactions processed by the Shared Service Center;
  • Taking ownership of VAT compliance, tax-related reporting, and statutory obligations across multiple European jurisdictions;
  • Coordinating annual audits and supporting the preparation of statutory financial statements;
  • Partnering with business teams to provide accounting and tax guidance on commercial and operational activities;
  • Ensuring compliance with local regulations, internal controls, and group accounting policies;
  • Identifying opportunities to streamline processes, strengthen controls, and drive continuous improvement initiatives;
  • Contributing to digitization and automation projects, including the adoption of innovative technologies and AI-driven solutions;

We are looking for a collaborative and flexible professional who enjoys taking ownership and working in a team-oriented environment. The ideal candidate combines technical accounting expertise with a strong process improvement mindset and has an interest in digital transformation and emerging technologies such as AI.

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field;
  • Minimum 4 years of accounting experience within an international or B2B environment;
  • Strong understanding of Belgian GAAP and VAT regulations;
  • Experience with statutory accounting and external audits;
  • Knowledge of SAP S/4HANA or SAP Hana is considered a strong asset;
  • Fluent in English and French; Dutch is a plus;
  • Analytical, detail-oriented, and process-minded;
  • Comfortable working with multiple stakeholders in an international environment;
  • Proactive, hands-on, and eager to contribute to continuous improvement initiatives;

title: Supervisor Gastenontvangst
description:
Functie

Ben jij een geboren gastheer of gastvrouw met een scherp oog voor detail en een natuurlijke flair voor leiderschap?

Wil je werken in de absolute topklasse van de Brugse hotellerie, maar mét behoud van een fijne work-lifebalance?

Dan is deze supervisor-rol jou op het lijf geschreven!

Voor een prachtig en exclusief hotel in het hartje van Brugge zoekt Vivaldis een gedreven Front of House Supervisor.

In deze rol ben jij hét operationele gezicht van het hotel en stuur je de dagelijkse beleving van de gasten én het team aan.

  • Hét gezicht van het ontbijt: Je verwelkomt de gasten met een glimlach, zorgt voor een vlekkeloze service en houdt de supervisie over het ontbijtrestaurant en de medewerkers.
  • Kwaliteitsbewaker (Housekeeping): Je hebt een scherp oog voor detail. Je maakt de dagelijkse planningen en kamerlijsten op voor het housekeeping-team. Voordat kamers worden vrijgegeven voor de check-in, doe jij de finale kwaliteitscontrole. Netheid staat bij jou op nummer één.
  • Organisatorisch talent: Je staat in voor de bestellingen van zowel de housekeeping als het ontbijt en zorgt dat er nooit iets tekortkomt.
  • Allround hospitality-held: Je bent 100% operationeel aanwezig op de vloer voor allerhande vragen van gasten. Waar nodig spring je tijdens drukke momenten bij aan de receptie om te ondersteunen bij de check-in en check-out.
Profiel

Jouw profiel:

  • Ervaring is een must: Je hebt reeds een bewezen track record binnen de hotellerie, bij voorkeur al in een (assisterende) leidinggevende of supervisor-rol.
  • Talenknopen: Je bent drietalig en communiceert moeiteloos in het Nederlands, Engels en Frans.
  • Hands-on & Teamplayer: Je denkt in oplossingen, stroopt graag zelf de mouwen op en weet je team te motiveren.
  • Gastgericht met oog voor detail: Je streeft naar perfectionisme. Alleen de allerbeste service is goed genoeg voor jouw gasten.
Wat je van ons krijgt
  • Een heel mooie en verantwoordelijke functie binnen een high-end, sfeervolle hotelomgeving.
  • Uitzonderlijke uren voor de hotellerie: Je werkt in een 5-daagse werkweek (uiteraard inclusief weekendwerk), waarbij je uren meestal tussen 07:30 u en 16:00 u liggen. Je avonden zijn dus lekker vrij!
  • Een aantrekkelijk salarispakket op supervisor-niveau, aangevuld met extralegale voordelen op basis van jouw ervaring.
  • Een job waarin je écht het verschil kunt maken en jouw stempel kunt drukken op de gastenbeleving.

Herken jij jezelf in deze omschrijving en ben je klaar om als supervisor te schitteren in Brugge?

Stuur dan snel je cv naar brugge@vivaldisoffice.be of neem telefonisch contact met ons op via 050 89 52 23.

Tot snel!

.

title: Assistant Food & Beverage Manager - Hotel - Brugge

Als Assistent F&B Manager ben je de rechterhand van de F&B Manager en een zichtbaar aanspreekpunt voor gasten en collega's.

Je combineert leidinggeven met actief meewerken op de werkvloer en zorgt mee voor een vlotte werking van het restaurant, de bar, meetings en events.

Wanneer de F&B Manager afwezig is, neem jij de dagelijkse operationele leiding op.

  • Werkt actief mee tijdens de service en springt bij waar nodig
  • Ondersteunt bij de personeelsplanning, voorraadbeheer en bestellingen
  • Ziet toe op de naleving van de geldende hygiëne, veiligheid en kwaliteitsnormen
  • Ondersteunt de F&B Manager bij administratieve en organisatorische taken
  • Bij afwezigheid van de F&B manager, neem je de operationele leiding op
  • Relevante ervaring binnen de horeca of hotelsector, bij voorkeur in een leidinggevende of coördinerende functie

title: Process Operator Pharma
description:
Onze klant, een biotech bedrijf, gevestigd in Zwijnaarde, is een wereldwijd biotechnologiebedrijf dat de innovatieve CAR-T celtheraptie naar Gent brengt. Het bedrijf maakt hiermee dagdagelijks het verschil in het leven van vele patiënten die lijden aan kanker en andere levensbedreigende ziektes.
Ze zijn momenteel in een fase van sterke groei en zoeken gemotiveerde en toegewijde teamleden. 


Jobomschrijving

2026 promises to be a year of exciting growth, and we want YOU to be part of our success story! We are looking for dedicated process operators to join our team at a leading biotechnology company. What can you expect in this exciting role?

This position is part of our talent pool. We are not actively recruiting for this position at the moment, but we will carefully keep track of your application and contact you when the role becomes available again.

Your journey begins with extensive training, where we immerse you in the world of aseptic (germ-free) and GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice) operations, including the crucial procedures you need to master.

Afterward, you will join our dynamic and driven Operations team, which works together every day to fulfill our mission. Alongside your fellow operators and team leaders, you will perform aseptic and manual production processes according to strict, proven procedures.

  • Daily aseptic and manual production processes
  • Executing production steps in controlled environments (grade A/B/C/D) Spiking
  • Media refreshing
  • Cell culture
  • Freezing therapeutic products
  • Managing equipment: inspections and maintenance
  • Thorough cleaning and disinfection of materials
  • Supporting transitions between production zones
  • Ensuring patients receive high-quality therapies on time

What does our client expect from you?

  • A strong sense of responsibility and a passion for making a difference in the lives of patients.
  • Clear communication with your colleagues and supervisor.
  • You love structure and order, are very accurate, and are willing to work in an aseptic environment with appropriate sterile clothing.
  • Experience in pharma or biotech is not required as we provide complete training.
  • You have a high school diploma (A2) or equivalent through experience. The mindset for quality and accuracy takes precedence over diploma and background.
  • You have good PC skills:
    Be able to add attachment to an email
    Be able to send / accept / modify teams invite
    Create document, save under PDF, ...

title: Reach truck operator
description:
TPCE (Toyota Parts Centre Europe) is Toyota's European distribution center. It supplies Toyota and Lexus parts to distributors throughout Europe. In addition, TPCE delivers directly to garages and dealerships in Belgium, Luxembourg, the Netherlands, Germany, and Northern France. At the Diest facility, imported Toyota and Lexus automotive parts are stored, orders for dealers and distributors are picked and assembled, and shipments are prepared and dispatched. TPCE is a modern, highly automated distribution center specializing in automotive parts logistics.


Jobomschrijving

Toyota Diest is looking for reach truck operators who are passionate about their profession and seeking a long-term career opportunity.

Are you the person we're looking for? Then Toyota is the right place for you!

As a Reach Truck Operator, your responsibilities include:

  • Order picking
  • Moving automotive parts and placing/removing them from warehouse racks
  • Stacking various pallets
  • ...

You will start working in a specific department, where you will learn all aspects of the operation. Over time, you will also become familiar with other departments. At Toyota, there is always room for growth and development! You will have the opportunity to develop into a fully-fledged Toyota team member. Who knows, you might even become Toyota's next supervisor or team leader.

Did you know that?

  • Toyota offers highly stable employment.
  • After approximately six months of employment, you may be offered a long-term contract.
  • Toyota grants permanent contracts to temporary agency workers twice a year.
  • More than 1,000 employees work at Toyota, making it one of the largest employers in the region.
  • Toyota encourages continuous development and promotes a culture based on teamwork and respect.
  • It is the ideal workplace for people who value innovation, people-oriented values, and a stable career.

Experience? Not necessary at all! We invest in our employees and provide comprehensive training. With the right attitude, you'll go a long way!

You are looking for a job where you can build a future. After positive performance evaluations, you may qualify for a permanent contract.

In addition:

  • You have experience operating a reach truck.
  • You are able to work in a two-shift system (5:50 AM - 2:00 PM and 1:50 PM - 10:00 PM).
  • Do you enjoy rolling up your sleeves and staying physically active? Great! Then Toyota is the right place for you.
  • Safety is your top priority.
  • You can travel independently to work. While we encourage carpooling, you must also be able to commute on your own when your carpool partner is unavailable. Public transport is not an option, considering your work hours.

title: Policy Officer - Consumer & Market Affairs
description:
The hiring organization is a respected entity focused on consumer advocacy and policy development. As a medium-sized organization, it is committed to addressing consumer needs through research, policy work, and collaboration with stakeholders.


Jobomschrijving

As a Policy Officer your responsibilities are:

  • Analyze and assess consumer policies with a focus on economic perspectives.
  • Develop and implement strategies for effective advocacy at the European and international levels.
  • Collaborate with internal teams and external stakeholders to advance consumer interests.
  • Monitor policy developments and identify opportunities to influence decision-making processes.
  • Prepare reports, briefings, and presentations to support policy positions.
  • Represent the organization in meetings, events, and consultations with policymakers and other stakeholders.
  • Provide expertise on economic aspects of consumer protection and market practices.
  • Contribute to the overall objectives of the Marketing & Agency department.

A successful Policy Officer should have:

  • A Master's degree in Economics or Business Studies.
  • Strong experience in European or international policy and advocacy.
  • Proficiency in assessing consumer policy areas, particularly from an economic perspective.
  • Excellent communication and analytical skills.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with diverse stakeholders.
  • A proactive and results-oriented approach to work.
  • Excellent level of English both written and verbal, French and Dutch is a plus.

title: Teamleader tankstation - Vast contract
description:
Klaar voor de volgende stap in de retail? Heb jij leidinggevende ambities, hou je van afwisseling en passen flexibele werkuren perfect in jouw privéleven? Dan is deze uitdaging iets voor jou!

Als teamleader ben je de rechterhand van de stationmanager en zorg je er samen met het team voor dat alles vlot verloopt. Afhankelijk van de grootte van het station neem je verantwoordelijkheid op binnen de shop, het restaurant, de administratie of een combinatie van deze domeinen.

Jouw taken:

  • Je ondersteunt de stationmanager in de dagelijkse werking.
  • Je stuurt collega's aan en begeleidt nieuwe medewerkers tijdens hun opleiding.
  • Je stelt de personeelsplanning op en voert evaluatiegesprekken.
  • Je beheert bestellingen, facturen en administratieve opvolging.
  • Je zorgt ervoor dat de shop en/of het restaurant steeds vlot en efficiënt draaien.
  • Geen enkele dag is dezelfde: je krijgt een gevarieerd takenpakket met veel verantwoordelijkheid én ruimte om initiatief te nemen.

Praktisch:

  • Voltijdse functie van 36 uur per week.
  • Flexibel uurrooster met shiften tussen 04.30 uur en 22.15 uur.
  • Afwisselend vroege, dag- en late shiften.
  • Je ontvangt je planning steeds ruim op voorhand, zodat je werk en privé goed kan combineren.
  • Flexibel uurrooster, weekendwerk of werken op feestdagen is voor jou geen probleem.
  • Eigen vervoer is belangrijk om tot aan het station te geraken.

title: HVAC-monteur
description:
Onze klant gelegen in Sint-Truiden is gespecialiseerd in HVAC-montage en technieken. Ze zijn niet een doorsnee chauffagist, maar staan voor duurzaamheid en innovatie. 's Morgens komen de monteurs samen in Sint-Truiden en vertrekken ze naar de verschillende werven, de techniekers vertrekken rechtstreeks van thuis met een camionette.
De werven zijn gelegen in Limburg, Vlaams-Brabant en Antwerpen. Ze werken zowel bij particuliere als op grote projecten. Als de werf of moet bundelen ze de krachten, maar kan het zijn dat je een overuur maakt. Over het algemeen is dit niet veel en werk je 8 uur per dag op de werf. Het bedrijf geeft graag kansen aan mensen zo zijn er dus ook doorgroeimogelijkheden binnen het bedrijf. Je komt hier terecht in een bedrijf met aangename sfeer.


Jobomschrijving

Voor de job als HVAC-monteur voor de regio van Sint-Truiden ben je verantwoordelijk voor:

  • Installeren van verwarming, sanitair en ventilatie
  • Gecombineerd met volgende technieken: zonneboilers, airco's, warmtepompen & zonneboilers (in mindere mate)
  • Focus op Samsung & Vaillant toestellen
  • Werven voor projectbouw (meerdere woningen of appartementen) of winkelbouw (provider winkels, zowel nieuwbouw als renovatie)

Dit heb je nodig voor de job

Voor de job als HVAC-monteur voor de regio van Sint-Truiden is het ideale profiel:

  • Je bent bereid te werken op werven over gans België
  • Kan werken zowel zelfstandig als in teamverband
  • Toont verantwoordelijkheidszin naar de eindklant
  • Komt terecht in een groeiende onderneming met een jong doch ervaren team
  • Hebt interesse in de wereld van de HVAC en diens continu evoluerende technieken

title: Teamleader tankstation
description:
Ben je op zoek naar een functie als verantwoordelijke in de verkoop met een wisselende uurrooster? Hou je van een job met voldoende uitdaging? En passen shiften perfect binnen jouw privéleven? Dan is deze vacature precies wat je zoekt!

Binnen ons team werken verschillende teamleaders, elk met hun eigen expertise.

Wat mag je zoal verwachten van het takenpakket?

  • Je ondersteunt de manager van het station waar nodig
  • Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de shop, administratie of het restaurant (in kleinere stations combineer je deze taken)
  • Je staat in voor facturatie, evaluatiegesprekken, personeelsplanning, opleiding van nieuwe collega’s, bestellingen en nog veel meer
  • Kortom: een job vol afwisseling en dynamiek.

Het gaat om een voltijdse functie van 36 uur per week, met uren die flexibel ingepland worden. Je werkt tussen 04u30 (ochtendshift) en 22u15 (avondshift), afwisselend in dag-, vroege en late diensten. Uiteraard ontvang je je uurrooster steeds tijdig.

  • Je hebt ervaring al in een eerdere leidinggevende functie
  • Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands voor een vlotte communicatie met het team en klanten
  • Je hebt eigen vervoer is belangrijk om tot aan het station te geraken, niet bereikbaar met openbaar vervoer

title: Operations Coordinator - Dutch & German speaking m/f/d (Callcenteragent/in)
description:
**Location:**  Ghent

Client confidential

Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future? If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match.

This is us, your new colleagues

You will work in a dynamic environment with colleagues from all over the world, where your team is your family away from home. Our diversity makes us stronger, as we speak 21 different languages in order to support our customers.

We are a 24/7 operation and our department is spread over three European sites – Ghent (Belgium), Rugby (UK) and Bucharest (Romania), as well as our team in Johannesburg (South Africa). Everyone shares a passion for giving the customer the best experience possible and solving any problems that might arise.

This is the job

- Our multi-lingual advisors utilise their language skills to support customers with international breakdowns. It doesn’t matter where they are in Europe, we take full ownership of the breakdown and give our customers a peace of mind.
- Communication is key. We are in regular dialogue with the dealer doing the repair and updating the customer with progress.
- A creative and proactive approach to problem solving ensures our customers are well supported. When things aren’t going smoothly, we think outside the box.
- Teamwork and collaboration are the foundations of our business

Are you the one?

- You are customer focused, always striving for the best possible service and solution for our customers.
- You are a confident communicator, adapting your style to each customer to make sure they feel heard and supported.
- You go the extra mile, solving problems with a proactive and creative mindset.
- You like working in a team, supporting and lifting each other up.
- You are keen to keep learning and developing your skills.
- You are open to working in shifts, just like your colleagues, to provide round-the-clock service to our clients.
- You are fluent (written and verbal) in English, Dutch and German.

A perfect match? Just some of the benefits working for us...

- Competitive salary, with meal vouchers, transport costs, shift allowance, etc.
- Well-being services
- Restaurant on site
- Opportunity to grow within the company
- Good work life balance
- International environment
- Support in relocation when moving from abroad

title: Shiftmanager Fastfood/Horeca
description:
Ben jij klaar voor de volgende stap als leidinggevende? Zoek je een job met veel doorgroeimogelijkheden, een hecht team en de zekerheid van een stabiele werkgever? Dan hebben wij dé kans voor jou!

In deze functie stuur je het team aan tijdens jouw shift. Je zorgt dat alles soepel loopt: van een vlotte service tot tevreden klanten. Samen met je collega’s bouw je mee aan een positieve werksfeer én aan jouw toekomst. Je krijgt volop kansen om door te groeien richting hogere managementrollen.

Waarom is dit dé job voor jou?

  • Je zet je leidinggevende skills in én bouwt ze verder uit.
  • Je werkt in een team waar samenwerking centraal staat.
  • Je krijgt begeleiding en kansen om door te groeien.
  • Als shiftmanager start je in de functie van 'gewone' medewerker voor ongeveer een maand, om de flow te leren kennen, daarna start je aan jouw opleidingstraject als shiftmanager. Ongeveer een half jaar een examen in NL later ben je klaar om jouw rol op te nemen.

Als shiftmanager stuur jij samen met een collega shiftmanager een team van 25 mensen aan. Jullie krijgen de planning een maand op voorhand door.

Doorheen de dag lossen jullie problemen op in het team of met klanten. Belangrijk dus om communicatief sterk in jouw schoenen te staan.

Je werkt in vaste uurblokken die zich situeren tussen 8u 's morgens en 01.00u 's avonds.

  • Je bent communicatief zeer sterk en weet hoe je een team moet aansturen. People management ligt jou.
  • Je bent flexibel in werktijden, zowel in avondwerk als weekendwerk.
  • Je bent klaar om te groeien, zowel als persoon als in functie.

title: Handyman / general facilities technician - English is allowed!
description:
Are you a hands-on technician with solid electrical knowledge and a passion for maintenance, repairs, and problem-solving? Do you enjoy having variety in your work and being the go-to person for all technical issues? And are you already living in Belgium?

For a growing transport and logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for a multi-skilled maintenance technician or handyman to help maintain the buildings, warehouse facilities, technical installations and outdoor areas. A very varied job that combines electrical maintenance, facility maintenance, repairs, troubleshooting and general handyman tasks. And the best part: Dutch isn't required, so you can also apply if you speak English very well!

Your role

As technician, you're responsible for a wide range of maintenance and repair activities across the different sites of the company. You and the rest of the technical team use your technical skills to ensure the operations run safely and efficiently.

Your key duties:

  • Perform electrical maintenance and repairs
  • Carry out minor repairs to plumbing, storage racks, equipment...
  • Keep up the company grounds and outdoor facilities
  • Help perform maintenance and repairs to the company vehicles
  • Supervise external contractors and service providers

Your profile:

  • Good knowledge of electrical systems and installations
  • Basic knowledge of plumbing, mechanics, building maintenance, or general technical repairs
  • Experience as a maintenance technician, handyman, facilities technician, general maintenance worker...
  • Own transportation to the company (no public transport nearby)
  • Very good knowledge of English

 

!! IMPORTANT ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS: please read carefully before applying !!

  • You must already be living in Belgium
  • You must already have a valid legal right to work in Belgium (EU citizenship or valid work permit)

Candidates who do not meet these requirements will not be considered for the position. We do not provide visa sponsorship, work permits, relocation support or immigration assistance.

title: English-speaking CE truck driver - frozen food transport
description:
Are you an experienced CE Driver who's living in Belgium and looking for a stable job? Do you hold a valid CE driving licence and code 95? And do you want to work at a reliable transport company where you can drive modern trucks and be home most evenings?

For a leading frozen food transport and logistics company in Oostkamp, we're recruiting a CE truck driver for delivering frozen food products to customers throughout Belgium and its neighbouring countries. Dutch isn't required for this job, so you're free to apply if you only speak English!

Your job

As a CE truck driver, lorry driver, or HGV driver, you will ensure the safe and on-time delivery of frozen food products to supermarkets, distribution centres, and business customers.

Your drives:

  • Transport of frozen goods
  • National deliveries throughout Belgium, but also to the Netherlands, Luxembourg, France and Germany 
  • Up to 15h/day on the road (waiting and resting times included)
  • Varying number of stops: between 5 to 15 stops/day

Routes are prepared in advance and your trailer is already loaded, connected, fuelled, and ready to go before departure.

You'll almost never have to sleep in your truck, except for some for very exceptional cases when there's no other possibility.

We're looking for a driver who:

  • Has a valid CE driving licence, code 95 and driver card
  • Is residing in Belgium and has legal right to work in the country
  • Has a good level of English
  • Isn't afraid to start early in the morning and to tackle longer routes
  • Has their own transport to the company (no public transport nearby truck cannot be taken home)

Previous experience in frozen food transport, refrigerated transport or distribution transport is an advantage but not required.

 

!! IMPORTANT ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS: please read carefully before applying !!

  • You must already be living in Belgium
  • You must already have a valid legal right to work in Belgium (EU citizenship or valid work permit)

Candidates who do not meet these requirements will not be considered for the position. We do not provide visa sponsorship, work permits, relocation support or immigration assistance.

title: Assistent restaurantmanager
description:
Onze klant is één van de grootste onafhankelijke retailers ter wereld.

De groep heeft een uitgebreid netwerk van vestigingen op internationale markten in Noord-Amerika, Europa en Australië.

Op vandaag is het bedrijf een toonaangevende speler op het gebied van food-to-go bij tankstations.

Onze klant wordt erkend voor zijn investeringsmodel, handelsprestaties en, nog belangrijker, het bieden van de beste ervaring in Retail, Foodservice en Brandstof.

De groep biedt een aantrekkelijk gamma aan erkende wereldmerken (zoals Starbucks, KFC en Burger King) die hun vestigingen omvormen tot een bestemming voor maaltijden en detailhandel die in meerdere behoeften van de klanten voorziet: van koffie over belegde broodjes tot fast food-maaltijden.

Elke dag leveren toegewijde medewerkers onvermoeibaar producten en diensten aan miljoenen klanten en steunen zij de lokale gemeenschappen waarin ze actief zijn.


Jobomschrijving

3 redenen om voor deze job te kiezen

  • Je werkt in een enthousiast, familiaal team
  • Je krijgt een goede verloning en extra voordelen
  • De job is afwisselend met doorgroeimogelijkheden


Zo ziet je job er uit

Als Assistent Restaurantmanager bij deze fastfoodketen ben jij de onmisbare rechterhand van de manager en draag je bij aan het dagelijks succes van de vestiging.

Jouw job bestaat uit:

  • het leiden van het team en samen met de collega's voor een klantgerichte werking zorgen
  • een enthousiaste en gemotiveerde sfeer op de werkvloer creëren
  • het opvolgen en streven naar het behalen van de verkoopdoelstellingen
  • nauw samenwerken met de manager, waarbij je rapporteert over de resultaten
  • assisteren bij taken zoals het opstellen van werkroosters, het beheren van de voorraad en het uitvoeren van kassawerkzaamheden
  • inspringen in de keuken of de bediening waar nodig om op die manier een voorbeeldfunctie te bekleden en de voeling met het dagelijks reilen en zeilen van het restaurant te behouden
  • het opnemen van de eindverantwoordelijkheid bij afwezigheid van de manager

Je draagt kortom bij aan de groei van het restaurant door je enthousiasme en klantgerichtheid, en je bent steeds bereid om operationele uitdagingen aan te pakken.

Dit heb je nodig voor de job

De perfecte Assistant Restaurantmanager herkent zich in onderstaande eigenschappen:

  • je hebt ervaring in horeca
  • je kan terugblikken op een eerste leidinggevende ervaring waarbij je een team moest aansturen
  • je bent enerzijds klantgericht, maar ook een echte teamplayer naar collega's toe
  • je bent energiek, positief en hands-on ingesteld
  • je kan goed plannen, organiseren en motiveren
  • je werkt graag in een afwisselend uurrooster met werkuren tussen 4u 's ochtends en 23u 's avonds
  • je bent bereid om in het weekend te werken, zowel op zaterdag als zondag
De ideale collega is...

De ideale collega is een geboren leider met een passie voor voeding en horeca.

Je hebt zin om te groeien in een leidinggevende functie, waarbij je administratieve taken combineert met operationeel meewerken op de vloer.

Je haalt energie uit een afwisselende job en bent in staat om een team te coachen en aan te sturen. Jij bent een expert in organiseren, delegeren en het nemen van initiatief. Ook onder druk weet je steeds het overzicht te bewaren.

Werken met een variabel uurrooster, inclusief weekends, schrikt jou niet af – integendeel, je geniet van de dynamiek die dit met zich meebrengt.

Je houdt van orde, netheid en zorgt ervoor dat de vestiging er altijd piekfijn uitziet. Je bent nauwkeurig bij het uitvoeren van papier- en kassawerk en weet klanten altijd met een grote glimlach te verwelkomen.

Je volgt samen met de manager de commerciële en financiële resultaten op en bent steeds op zoek naar verbeteringen.

Je steekt graag de handen uit de mouwen en bent flexibel inzetbaar.

Kortom, jij bent een enthousiaste Assistant Restaurantmanager die het verschil maakt.

title: Business Analyst  & Transformation Project lead
description:
Our client, an international organisation active in technical services and customer support, is undergoing a major digital transformation across its European operations. To support this journey, they are looking for an experienced Business Analyst & Transformation Project Lead .

In this key position within the organization , you will drive business improvement initiatives, manage strategic projects, and act as the link between operational teams and IT.

Project & Programme Management

  • Define priorities, timelines, budgets, and project deliverables.
  • Coordinate stakeholders and ensure projects are delivered on time and within scope.
  • Identify and mitigate risks throughout the project lifecycle.

Business Process Improvement

  • Analyse existing business processes and identify opportunities for optimisation.
  • Drive initiatives focused on standardisation, automation, and digitalisation.
  • Support the development of scalable and efficient operational practices.

Requirements Analysis

  • Gather, analyse, and document business requirements.

  • Solution Development

Collaborate closely with IT and business systems teams.

Commercial & Supplier Management

  • Support and lead commercial initiatives related to projects and business improvements.
  • Manage relationships with external suppliers and service providers.
  • Participate in contract discussions and monitor project budgets and performance.

 

Stakeholder Management

  • Act as the primary contact between business operations and IT teams
  • Build strong relationships across departments and facilitate effective communication.
  • Ensure business priorities are clearly understood and aligned.
  • Has proven experience managing business transformation projects and programmes.
  • Demonstrates strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Is comfortable working with data and translating insights into actionable recommendations.
  • Possesses strong commercial awareness and can assess the business impact of decisions.
  • Has experience gathering and documenting business requirements.
  • Can communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Builds strong working relationships and influences stakeholders at different levels.
  • Thrives in a dynamic environment and can manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Has experience working with IT, ERP, CRM, or other business systems teams.
  • Is fluent in English; knowledge of Dutch and/or French  is considered an asset.

title: SYSTEEMBEHEERDER ICT & AI KRINGWINKEL
description:
Als systeembeheerder ben je het eerste aanspreekpunt voor alles wat met IT te maken heeft: van een collega die niet kan inloggen tot een nieuwe winkel die van netwerk tot kassa klaargezet moet worden. Je houdt onze volledig cloudgebaseerde omgeving gezond en veilig. En je bouwt mee aan slimme automatisering en AI, samen met de algemeen directeur en de collega's van de overkoepelende Kringwinkel Groep. Je krijgt de ruimte om te leren en te groeien in een vak dat snel beweegt.

FUNCTIE

Dagelijks beheer en ondersteuning

  • Beheer van gebruikers, licenties en rechten in Microsoft 365, SharePoint en Entra ID
  • Installeren, beveiligen en beheren van laptops, pc's, tablets en printers in winkels, magazijn en kantoor
  • Opvolgen van netwerken en wifi op al onze locaties, samen met onze leveranciers
  • Bewaken van back-ups, updates, antivirus en toegangsrechten
  • Opzetten van de IT voor nieuwe of vernieuwde winkels

Automatisering

  • Samen met collega's van administratie, HR, winkels en logistiek bekijken waar terugkerend werk geautomatiseerd kan worden
  • Bouwen van automatiseringen met Power Automate, Microsoft 365 en AI-tools, en ze onderhouden
  • Helpen bij koppelingen tussen onze systemen (kassa, planning, boekhouding, webshop)
  • Documenteren wat je bouwt, zodat collega's ermee verder kunnen

AI in de praktijk

  • Collega's opleiden om Claude en ChatGPT slim en veilig te gebruiken in hun dagelijks werk: korte leermomenten en begeleiding op de werkvloer
  • Meewerken aan eigen AI-toepassingen: skills, agents en geplande taken voor administratie en rapportering
  • Mee bijhouden van het AI-register en de afspraken rond gevoelige gegevens
  • Nieuwe toepassingen uitproberen, zoals AI-ondersteuning bij de intake van goederen

Leveranciers en Kringwinkel Groep

  • Dagelijks contact met onze IT-leveranciers en opvolging van tickets en contracten
  • Samenwerken met de IT-collega's van Kringwinkel Groep: gedeelde systemen, gedeelde kennis
  • Thuis in Microsoft 365: SharePoint, Entra ID en Intune, of je leert ze snel; je hebt al toestellen en gebruikers beheerd
  • Handig met netwerken en hardware: je installeert een toestel, lost een netwerkprobleem op en weet wanneer je de leverancier belt
  • Zin in automatisering: Power Automate, scripting of low-code, je hebt er al mee gewerkt of wil het graag leren
  • Nieuwsgierig naar AI: je gebruikt zelf AI-tools zoals Claude of ChatGPT en ziet waar ze collega's kunnen helpen
  • Vriendelijk en geduldig: je legt IT uit aan mensen die er niet van houden, zonder jargon en zonder zuchten
  • Flexibel in taken en denken: je schakelt vlot van een helpdeskvraag naar een automatisering en past je aanpak aan wanneer de situatie daarom vraagt
  • Diploma: bachelor toegepaste informatica, elektronica-ICT of gelijkwaardig. Ander diploma maar je toont aan dat je dit kan? Dan lezen we je sollicitatie even graag.
  • Affiniteit met de sociale economie is een pluspunt

Strategie en samenwerking

  • Opmaken en opvolgen van de digitale roadmap en het ICT- en AI-budget
  • Slimme samenwerking met de overkoepelende Kringwinkel Groep: gedeelde systemen, gedeelde kennis en gedeelde kosten waar dat zinvol is
  • Adviseren van directie en management over digitale keuzes en investeringen
  • Expert in Microsoft 365 en toestelbeheer: SharePoint, Intune, Entra ID of gelijkwaardig; netwerken en beveiliging in een organisatie met meerdere locaties
  • Interesse in automatisering: Power Automate, scripting of low-code; je hebt er al mee gewerkt of je wil je er graag in verdiepen
  • Hands-on met AI: je werkt zelf met AI-tools zoals Claude of ChatGPT en begrijpt wat ze wel en niet kunnen
  • Procesdenker: je kijkt naar het werk achter de techniek en vertaalt een probleem naar een concrete oplossing met budget en timing
  • Heldere communicator: je legt techniek uit aan een winkelmedewerker en aan het bestuur, en je luistert eerst
  • Flexibel in taken en denken: je schakelt vlot tussen een strategisch plan en een vastgelopen printer, en je past je aanpak aan wanneer de situatie daarom vraagt
  • Diploma: master in informatica, ingenieur ICT, AI, statistiek, data science, handelsingenieur of kwantitatieve economie, of gelijkwaardig door aantoonbare expertise

    Good computer skills and ability to work with multiple systems
    Availability to work 09:00–18:00, Monday to Friday

    Experience working with CRM or ticketing systems

🎁 What You’ll Get

    Additional health insurance

You will receive structured training and ongoing support while developing your customer service and communication skills in an international environment.

Join us and become part of a team that delivers exceptional customer experiences every day. Apply now and start your journey with Sutherland.

title: Digital Transformation Services Lead (Hybrid)
description:
WorkNomads is on the hunt for a Head of Digital Transformation to join our team!



Who We Are:

We are building a community where global talent is geographically unleashed, and diversity is celebrated. We champion the freedom of living and working across borders, shaping a nation without a country.

·       Remote engineering services, global impact — expert engineering, design, and business talent in cross-disciplinary project teams.

·       Diversity celebrated — 40+ nationalities, 4 continents, one team.

·       Continuous growth — we invest in you: projects, coliving, community, pushing you beyond what you thought possible.



Your mission at WorkNomads:

The Digital Transformation Services Lead is responsible for reimagining and modernizing Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) service delivery by introducing digital, AI-enabled, and architecture-led operating models. Leveraging an enterprise architecture background, this role bridges business strategy, technology, and operations to transform how services are designed, delivered, measured, and continuously improved.

As the strategic technology leader for service transformation, the role also provides direction and governance to the IT organization, ensuring technology investments, platforms, and architecture enable the future state of service delivery.

Working in close partnership with Operations leadership to understand service performance, customer needs, and operational challenges through data-driven insights, the role actively uncovers commercial opportunities by identifying new digital capabilities, value-added services, and innovation initiatives that expand the client's service portfolio, strengthen strategic partnerships, and drive sustainable revenue growth and profitability.

Key Responsibilities

Service Transformation Strategy

Define and execute the digital transformation strategy for customer service accounts and managed services.

Design future-state operating models that leverage AI, automation, analytics, cloud technologies, and digital platforms.

Transform traditional BPO delivery into standardized, technology-enabled, and data-driven service models.

Establish scalable frameworks that can be replicated across multiple accounts and business units.



Enterprise Architecture & Technology Leadership

Apply Enterprise Architecture principles to align business capabilities, processes, applications, data, and technology with strategic objectives.

Define the target architecture for digital service delivery and guide the evolution of supporting technology platforms.

Ensure technology decisions support scalability, interoperability, security, governance, and operational excellence.

Lead and steer the IT organization in delivering technology capabilities that support business transformation.

Partner with IT leaders to prioritize investments, modernize platforms, and accelerate innovation.



Innovation & New Ways of Working

Introduce proven operational and digital practices from industries such as financial services, manufacturing, healthcare, logistics, and technology into the BPO environment.

Challenge existing service delivery models and drive continuous innovation.

Promote Agile, DevSecOps, product-oriented delivery, platform thinking, and automation-first principles across service operations.

Foster a culture of experimentation, continuous improvement, and technology adoption.



Operational Excellence

Redesign business processes to improve efficiency, quality, resilience, and customer experience.

Establish governance models, KPIs, dashboards, and performance metrics that provide end-to-end visibility into service performance.

Standardize processes and operating procedures to improve consistency across accounts.

Ensure transformation initiatives deliver measurable operational and financial outcomes.



Commercial Growth

Identify opportunities to expand service scope through digital capabilities, AI solutions, automation, consulting, and managed services.

Partner with Sales, Account Management, and Client Success teams to develop transformation roadmaps and business cases.

Position the organization as a strategic digital transformation partner for clients.

Support revenue growth through upselling, cross-selling, and innovative service offerings.



Financial & Value Realization

Improve account profitability through technology-enabled productivity gains and optimized delivery models.

Develop business cases that quantify expected benefits, ROI, and cost savings.

Track realization of transformation benefits and continuously optimize value delivery.



Leadership & Stakeholder Management

Lead cross-functional transformation programs involving Operations, IT, Digital, AI, Product, and Client teams.

Influence senior executives and client stakeholders on transformation priorities and investment decisions.

Mentor operational and technology leaders in digital transformation, enterprise architecture, and modern service delivery practices.

Build strong collaboration between business and IT to ensure successful execution.

Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related discipline.

Enterprise Architecture experience with a strong understanding of business architecture, application architecture, data architecture, and technology architecture.

10+ years of experience in digital transformation, enterprise architecture, IT strategy, or service transformation.

Experience within BPO, customer operations, shared services, managed services, or large-scale service organizations.

Demonstrated success leading digital transformation initiatives involving AI, automation, cloud, analytics, and modern enterprise platforms.

Experience leading technology teams and influencing enterprise-wide transformation programs.

Knowledge of Enterprise Architecture frameworks (e.g., TOGAF) is an advantage.

Familiarity with Agile, DevSecOps, ITIL, Lean, Six Sigma, or Product Operating Models is preferred.

title: Svensktalande E-Commerce Advisor i Bulgarien
description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they are doing!

We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.

Concentrix Bulgaria is now looking for a number of dynamic and self-motivated Customer Advisors to join our exciting new project.

VF is the global company behind some of the world’s leading lifestyle brands including household names such as, Timberland, The North Face, Napapijri, Lee, Wrangler, Vans Eastpak and Kipling
Our aim is to consistently deliver world class customer service and we never lose sight of our goal - our customers are the focus of everything we do here! From email to phone in a multitude of languages, we’re on hand to offer care to all our customers to make sure they have a fun and enjoyable shopping experience with us.  

We’re an energetic, innovative and forward thinking team who are always looking for new ideas to delight and wow our customers.  The Customer Advisor is required to:

•    Be proficient (verbal & written) in Swedish
•    Be advanced in English
•    Be able to represent our client’s brands and deliver outstanding customer service with clarity, passion and enthusiasm
•    Be flexible to meet the changing needs and varying deadlines of our business
•    Be able to work to customer service measures, metrics and KPIs within a service targeted environment.
•    Hold a High-school or University degree
•    Possess excellent computer literacy
•    Have previous experience in a customer service environment, preferably telephone based.

Main responsibilities:

•    Communicating with customers by telephone, email and online to provide outstanding service
•    Building a rapport with customers to help them with enquiries including; order taking, product information, tracking deliveries, returns, sizing and quality queries
•    Discussing new products and managing multiple tasks to promptly resolve customer queries
•    Identifying ways to improve processes in order to improve sales, brand loyalty and the customer service and experience
•    Updating our systems with information and helping marketing, retail and other teams to further improve customer service and satisfaction.
Who are we:
Concentrix, a wholly owned subsidiary of SYNNEX Corporation (NYSE: SNX), is a leading business services company. We focus on customer engagement and improving business outcomes for over 450 global clients across many continents. Our 100,000+ staff deliver technology-infused, omni-channel customer experience management, marketing optimization, digital, consulting, analytics and back office solutions in 40+ languages from 125+ delivery centres. We serve automotive; banking and financial services; insurance; healthcare; technology; consumer electronics; media and communications; retail and e-commerce; travel and transportation; and energy and public-sector clients.

title: Customer Support Associate with Norwegian & English – Sofia, Bulgaria
description:
For more than 37 years, Sutherland has been a global leader in Customer Experience Management (CXM). As a pioneer in automation and innovative customer solutions, we deliver exceptional service on behalf of our clients worldwide.

With operations in 60 countries and a presence in Bulgaria since 2008, our diverse team of more than 2,000 professionals supports customers in 17 different languages from Sofia, Varna, Burgas, and remote locations.

🎯 About the Role

We are looking for a Customer Support Associate with Danish and English to join our team supporting customers of a leading international telecommunications provider.

You will assist customers through inbound voice and non-voice channels, including phone, email, and chat, with day-to-day service-related questions such as top-ups, SIM activation, roaming usage, and general account inquiries. This is a pure customer service role with no sales, upselling, or device troubleshooting.

Key Responsibilities

    Handle inbound customer inquiries via phone, email, chat, and other supported channels
    Assist customers with top-ups, SIM activation, roaming usage, and general service-related questions

🧠 What We’re Looking For

Must-have:

    Norwegian – minimum B2 level
    English – minimum B2 level
    Undergraduate, graduate, postgraduate education or equivalent
    Strong verbal and written communication skills
    Good computer skills and ability to work with multiple systems
    Availability to work 09:00–18:00, Monday to Friday

Nice-to-have:

    Previous experience in customer service, BPO, telecommunications, or a similar environment
    Experience working with CRM or ticketing systems
    Strong problem-solving skills and a customer-focused mindset

🎁 What You’ll Get

Compensation & Benefits:

    Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses
    Additional health insurance
    Food vouchers
    3 weeks of paid training in English, followed by accreditation
    Relocation support to Sofia for eligible candidates

Work Environment:

    Onsite from our Sofia office
    Working hours: 09:00–18:00, Monday to Friday
    Voice and non-voice customer support

Growth & Development

You will receive structured training and ongoing support while developing your customer service and communication skills in an international environment.

🚀 Ready to Apply?

Join us and become part of a team that delivers exceptional customer experiences every day. Apply now and start your journey with Sutherland.

title: Digital Transformation Services Lead (Hybrid)
description:
WorkNomads is on the hunt for a Head of Digital Transformation to join our team!



Who We Are:

We are building a community where global talent is geographically unleashed, and diversity is celebrated. We champion the freedom of living and working across borders, shaping a nation without a country.

·       Remote engineering services, global impact — expert engineering, design, and business talent in cross-disciplinary project teams.

·       Diversity celebrated — 40+ nationalities, 4 continents, one team.

·       Continuous growth — we invest in you: projects, coliving, community, pushing you beyond what you thought possible.



Your mission at WorkNomads:

The Digital Transformation Services Lead is responsible for reimagining and modernizing Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) service delivery by introducing digital, AI-enabled, and architecture-led operating models. Leveraging an enterprise architecture background, this role bridges business strategy, technology, and operations to transform how services are designed, delivered, measured, and continuously improved.

As the strategic technology leader for service transformation, the role also provides direction and governance to the IT organization, ensuring technology investments, platforms, and architecture enable the future state of service delivery.

Working in close partnership with Operations leadership to understand service performance, customer needs, and operational challenges through data-driven insights, the role actively uncovers commercial opportunities by identifying new digital capabilities, value-added services, and innovation initiatives that expand the client's service portfolio, strengthen strategic partnerships, and drive sustainable revenue growth and profitability.

Key Responsibilities

Service Transformation Strategy

Define and execute the digital transformation strategy for customer service accounts and managed services.

Design future-state operating models that leverage AI, automation, analytics, cloud technologies, and digital platforms.

Transform traditional BPO delivery into standardized, technology-enabled, and data-driven service models.

Establish scalable frameworks that can be replicated across multiple accounts and business units.



Enterprise Architecture & Technology Leadership

Apply Enterprise Architecture principles to align business capabilities, processes, applications, data, and technology with strategic objectives.

Define the target architecture for digital service delivery and guide the evolution of supporting technology platforms.

Ensure technology decisions support scalability, interoperability, security, governance, and operational excellence.

Lead and steer the IT organization in delivering technology capabilities that support business transformation.

Partner with IT leaders to prioritize investments, modernize platforms, and accelerate innovation.



Innovation & New Ways of Working

Introduce proven operational and digital practices from industries such as financial services, manufacturing, healthcare, logistics, and technology into the BPO environment.

Challenge existing service delivery models and drive continuous innovation.

Promote Agile, DevSecOps, product-oriented delivery, platform thinking, and automation-first principles across service operations.

Foster a culture of experimentation, continuous improvement, and technology adoption.



Operational Excellence

Redesign business processes to improve efficiency, quality, resilience, and customer experience.

Establish governance models, KPIs, dashboards, and performance metrics that provide end-to-end visibility into service performance.

Standardize processes and operating procedures to improve consistency across accounts.

Ensure transformation initiatives deliver measurable operational and financial outcomes.



Commercial Growth

Identify opportunities to expand service scope through digital capabilities, AI solutions, automation, consulting, and managed services.

Partner with Sales, Account Management, and Client Success teams to develop transformation roadmaps and business cases.

Position the organization as a strategic digital transformation partner for clients.

Support revenue growth through upselling, cross-selling, and innovative service offerings.



Financial & Value Realization

Improve account profitability through technology-enabled productivity gains and optimized delivery models.

Develop business cases that quantify expected benefits, ROI, and cost savings.

Track realization of transformation benefits and continuously optimize value delivery.



Leadership & Stakeholder Management

Lead cross-functional transformation programs involving Operations, IT, Digital, AI, Product, and Client teams.

Influence senior executives and client stakeholders on transformation priorities and investment decisions.

Mentor operational and technology leaders in digital transformation, enterprise architecture, and modern service delivery practices.

Build strong collaboration between business and IT to ensure successful execution.

Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related discipline.

Enterprise Architecture experience with a strong understanding of business architecture, application architecture, data architecture, and technology architecture.

10+ years of experience in digital transformation, enterprise architecture, IT strategy, or service transformation.

Experience within BPO, customer operations, shared services, managed services, or large-scale service organizations.

Demonstrated success leading digital transformation initiatives involving AI, automation, cloud, analytics, and modern enterprise platforms.

Experience leading technology teams and influencing enterprise-wide transformation programs.

Knowledge of Enterprise Architecture frameworks (e.g., TOGAF) is an advantage.

Familiarity with Agile, DevSecOps, ITIL, Lean, Six Sigma, or Product Operating Models is preferred.

Posebno znanje: -posjedovanje osnovnih tehničkih znanja o elementima strojeva -korištenje i razumijevanje tehničke dokumentacije, -čitanje el. shema, poznavanje i rukovanje mjernim instrumentima te ostalom elektro opremom

Uz napisanu prijavu na natječaj kandidati su dužni priložiti:

1. životopis 2. dokaz o stečenoj stučnoj spremi 3. uvjerenje da nije pod istragom i da se protiv kandidata ne vodi kazneni postupak (uvjerenje nadležnog suda nije starije od 30 dana od dana objave natječaja)

title: TEHNIČAR/KA ZA PRIPREMU SMJENE
description:
HRVATSKI DUHANI d.d. dio su grupe British American Tobacco, jedna od vodećih svjetskih multinacionalnih kompanija u području duhanske industrije. Zahvaljujući našim zaposlenicima nastavili smo rasti, stoga tražimo motiviranu i odgovornu osobu za rad na poziciji: Tehničar/ka za pripremu smjene Glavne odgovornosti i zadaci:
  • Zaduženje za održavanje strojeva linije obrade duhana i otklanjanje pronađenih nedostataka najranije moguće.
  • Dnevno kontrolira čišćenje, podmazivanje, kontrole curenja ulja na svim strojevima.
  • Svakodnevno provjeravanje podešenosti strojeva te izvršenje potrebnih podešavanja.
  • Dnevna kontrola i otklanjanje kvarova na sustavu linija otprašivanja.
  • Popravak i remont linija obrade duhana, linija sjetve i otkupa duhana te popravci i zamjena mehaničkih komponenata i sklopova na opremi iz svog djelokruga.
  • Redovno provjerava radno stanje opreme, radi tehnička podešavanja, obavještava Rukovoditelja održavanja o uočenim problemima.
  • Radi na smanjenju potrošnje energije.
  • Izrada dijelova u skladu sa dostavljenim specifikacijama.
  • Rastavljanje strojeva u slučaju potrebe, popravak i zamjena neispravnih komponenti strojeva.
  • Sudjeluje u instalaciji proizvodne opreme i strojeva.
  • Nadzire rad opreme i strojeva, brine o hidraulučnim platformama i pometačima podova u pogonu.
  • Održava čistoću i urednost radnog okruženja.
  • Sudjeluje u pripremi akcija preventivnog održavanja.
  • Osigurava da su svi alati i materijali koji se koriste prikladni, sigurni i u skladu s relevantnim standardima i zahtjevima tvrtke.
  • Održavanje, popravci i zamjena mehaničkih komponenata i sklopova na opremi iz svogdjelokruga.
  • Po potrebi radi u drugim sektorima, sva područja obrade duhana (pakiranje, sušenje, biranje, ulaz, itd.), na sjetvi plitica, otkupu duhana.
  • Ostali zadaci u skladu s naravi i vrstom rada po nalogu neposredno nadređenog.
Uvjeti
  • Potrebna stručna sprema: SSS-srednja stručna sprema.
  • Zahtijevana struka: tehnička struke (elektro, strojarska).
  • Osnovno znanje engleskog jezika u govoru i pismu.
  • Osnovno znanje rada na računalu: Ms Office.
  • Vozačka dozvola B kategorije.
Prednosti
  • Sposobnost brze identifikacije i rješavanja problema.
  • Iskustvo u razumijevanju tehničke dokumentacije.
  • Izvrsna sposobnost vođenja evidencije.
  • Komunikacijske vještine.
  • Fleksibilnost i timski rad.
  • Sposobnost postavljanja prioriteta.
  • Poželjno radno iskustvo od dvije godine u struci ili na sličnim poslovima.
Nudimo benefite i pogodnosti:
  • Briga o zdravlju: dopunsko i dodatno zdravstveno osiguranje (sistematski i specijalistički pregledi i slično), osiguranje zaposlenika od nezgode (24/7), besplatno korištenje teretane.
  • Financijske pogodnosti: Božićnica, regres za godišnji odmor, naknada za podmirivanje troškova prehrane, potpora za rođenje djeteta, naknada za troškove prijevoza, itd.
  • Priznanja i nagrade: godišnji bonus, godišnja korekcija plaće, razna nefinacijska nagrađivanja putem nominacija za prepoznavanje truda i postignuća.
  • Balans privatnog i poslovnog: plaćeni i neplaćeni dopust za razne osobne potrebe, slobodan radni dan povodom rođendana zaposlenika, razna online savjetovanja za zaposlenike i programi pomoći te savjetovanja za razne životne teme.
  • Okruženje koje pokreće: podršku od strane kolega i voditelja, kontinuirani razvoj kroz stručno usavršavanje, obilježavanje događaja gdje slavimo uspjeh i izražavamo zahvalnost prema našim zaposlenicima.
Trajanje ugovora: Na određeno vrijeme s mogućnošću zasnivanja radnog odnosa na neodređeno vrijeme. Raspon bruto I plaće: 1.080,00 – 1.350,00 € Životopis i molbu dostaviti na e-mail adresu: posao_hd@bat.com uz obaveznu naznaku u naslovu mail-a za koji točno natječaj se prijavljujete. Prijavite se na oglas i pridružite se uspješnoj međunarodnoj grupi. Veselimo se Vašoj prijavi!

title: PROJEKTANT SURADNIK/PROJEKTANTICA SURADNICA
description:
PROJEKTANT SURADNIK (m/ž)

Za rad u projektantskom uredu tražimo motiviranu i odgovornu osobu za radno mjesto Projektant suradnik (m/ž).

Opis posla

Projektant suradnik sudjeluje u izradi arhitektonskih projekata kroz različite faze projektiranja, u suradnji s glavnim projektantom i ostalim članovima projektnog tima.

Glavne odgovornosti uključuju:

  • sudjelovanje u izradi idejnih, glavnih i izvedbenih projekata

  • izradu i razradu arhitektonske projektne dokumentacije

  • izradu tehničkih nacrta, detalja i grafičkih priloga

  • sudjelovanje u razvoju projektnih rješenja

  • usklađivanje projektne dokumentacije s ostalim strukama

  • pripremu dokumentacije za ishođenje potrebnih dozvola i suglasnosti

  • komunikaciju i koordinaciju s kolegama, suradnicima i ostalim sudionicima u projektu

  • praćenje projekta i izvršavanje zadataka prema dogovorenim rokovima

  • sudjelovanje u obilascima lokacija i gradilišta prema potrebi

Uvjeti i očekivanja

Od kandidata očekujemo:

  • završeno odgovarajuće obrazovanje iz područja arhitekture, graditeljstva ili srodnog tehničkog područja

  • poznavanje rada u relevantnim programima za projektiranje i izradu tehničke dokumentacije

  • preciznost, odgovornost i organiziranost

  • sposobnost timskog rada i kvalitetne komunikacije

  • samostalnost u izvršavanju povjerenih zadataka u skladu s razinom iskustva

  • spremnost na učenje i profesionalni razvoj

Radno iskustvo na sličnim poslovima je prednost, ali razmotrit ćemo i kandidate s manje iskustva koji pokazuju znanje, motivaciju i želju za učenjem.

Mjesto i način rada

Rad se obavlja na licu mjesta, u prostorijama projektantskog ureda.

Tražimo osobu koja će biti svakodnevno prisutna u uredu i aktivno sudjelovati u radu projektnog tima. Ovo radno mjesto nije predviđeno za rad na daljinu (remote) niti isključivo online suradnju.

Što nudimo

  • rad na raznovrsnim arhitektonskim i projektantskim zadacima

  • rad u profesionalnom i suradničkom okruženju

  • mogućnost učenja i razvoja stručnih znanja

  • sudjelovanje u svim fazama razvoja projekta

  • stabilnu i dugoročnu suradnju

  • mogućnost profesionalnog napredovanja u skladu sa znanjem, iskustvom i rezultatima

Ako ste zainteresirani za rad u projektantskom uredu i želite biti dio tima koji zajednički razvija i realizira projekte, pozivamo vas da nam pošaljete svoj životopis i, ako je primjenjivo, portfolio dosadašnjih rad

title: UČITELJ/UČITELJICA RAZREDNE NASTAVE NA TALIJANSKOM JEZIKU U PRODUŽENOM BORAVKU
description:
Na temelju članka 107. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (NN 87/08, 86/09, 92/10,105/10-ispr., 90/11, 5/12, 16/12. 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23 i 156/23) i sukladno Pravilniku o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja radnika u OŠ-SE „San Nicolò“ te čl. 7. Pravilnika o radu OŠ-SE „San Nicolò“, ravnateljica Osnovne škole-Scuola elementare „San Nicolò“ Rijeka, Mirka Čurbega 18, objavljuje N A T J E Č A J za popunjenje radnog mjesta učitelja/učiteljice razredne nastave na talijanskom jeziku u produženom boravku na neodređeno i puno radno vrijeme – 2 izvršitelja/izvršiteljice, uz uvjet probnog rada prema odredbama Temeljnog kolektivnog ugovora za službenike i namještenike u javnim službama TRAŽENI UVJETI: 1. Prema čl. 105. i 106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (NN 87/08., 86/09., 92/10.,105/10.-ispr., 90/11., 5/12., 16/12., 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17 i 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23, 156/23), sukladno Pravilniku o odgovarajućoj vrsti obrazovanja učitelja i stručnih suradnika u osnovnoj školi (NN br. 6/19, 75/20) i temeljem Odluke o organizaciji i provedbi produženog boravka i cjelodnevnog odgojno-obrazovnog rada u osnovnim školama Grada Rijeke („Službene novine Grada Rijeke“ broj 4. – godina XII): - završen sveučilišni diplomski studij - potpuno vladanje talijanskim jezikom i pismom 2. Prema Zakonu o odgoju i obrazovanju na jeziku i pismu nacionalnih manjina (NN 51/00.,56/00-ispr.). Na oglašena radna mjesta mogu se javiti osobe oba spola, sukladno čl. 13. Zakona o ravnopravnosti spolova (NN 82/16, 69/17). Svi izrazi korišteni u natječaju odnose se na osobe oba spola. Uz vlastoručno potpisanu prijavu kandidati su dužni priložiti:
  • životopis (CV) sastavljen na hrvatskom i na talijanskom jeziku,
  • presliku diplome, odnosno dokaz o stečenoj stručnoj spremi,
  • dokaz o državljanstvu,
  • elektronički zapis ili potvrdu o podacima evidentiranim u bazi podataka Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje i
  • uvjerenje da se protiv kandidata ne vodi kazneni postupak glede zapreka za zasnivanje radnog odnosa iz čl. 106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi, ne starije od 6 mjeseci od dana objave ovog natječaja.
Navedenu dokumentaciju potrebno je dostaviti poštom preporučeno na adresu škole, u roku od 8 dana od dana objave ovog natječaja na mrežnoj stranici Škole i mrežnoj stranici Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje. Isprave se prilažu u neovjerenoj preslici. Kandidati koji ostvaruju prednost pri zapošljavanju prema posebnim propisima, dužni su u prijavi pozvati se na to pravo i priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta i priznatom statusu. Osobe koje se pozivaju na pravo prednosti sukladno članku 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), članku 48. f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (Narodne novine broj 33/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03 i 148/13, 98/19), članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine broj 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20) te članku 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine broj 84/21, 13/26), dužne su u prijavi na javni natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i uz prijavu priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu, a imaju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Osobe koje ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine broj 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), uz prijavu na natječaj dužne su priložiti i dokaze propisane člankom 103. stavak 1. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji. Poveznica na internetsku stranicu Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja s popisom dokaza potrebnih za ostvarivanje prava prednosti: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/NG/12%20Prosinac/Zapo%C5%A1ljavanje/Popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju.pdf Osobe koje ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine broj 84/21, 13/26), uz prijavu na natječaj dužne su u prijavi na natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i uz prijavu dostaviti i dokaze iz stavka 1. članka 49. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata. Poveznica na internetsku stranicu Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja s popisom dokaza potrebnih za ostvarivanje prava prednosti: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf Kandidati koji su dostavili potpune i pravovremene prijave i koji ispunjavaju formalne uvjete natječaja sudjeluju u daljnjem postupku te će biti pozvani na vrednovanje. Vrednovanje uključuje: psihologijsko testiranje, provjera poznavanja talijanskog jezika za kandidate koji nisu završili najmanje jedan obrazovni ciklus na talijanskom jeziku, sastav motivacijskog pisma i intervju, sve u skladu s odredbama članaka 12. – 14. Pravilnika o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja u Osnovnoj školi – Scuola elementare „San Nicolò“. Nepotpune i nepravovremene prijave neće se razmatrati. Povjerenstvo za provedbu testiranja će postupiti sukladno odredbama Pravilnika o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja u OŠ-SE „San Nicolò“ u odnosu na sve kandidate, koji udovoljavaju propisanim uvjetima, a podnijeli su potpune i pravovremene prijave. Kandidat koji se ne odazove pozivu za bilo koju fazu vrednovanja, smatrat će se da je odustao od daljnjeg natječajnog postupka. Prijavom na natječaj kandidati daju privolu za obradu osobnih podataka navedenih u svim dostavljenim prilozima odnosno ispravama za potrebe provedbe natječajnog postupka. Škola će u roku od 8 dana od donošenja odluke o izboru kandidata obavijestiti sve kandidate o rezultatima natječaja objavom odluke na mrežnoj stranici Škole ili osobno putem elektroničke pošte. Natječaj je objavljen na mrežnoj stranici škole, te na mrežnoj stranici Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje dana 10. rujna 2026. godine. Ai sensi dell'articolo 107 della Legge sull’educazione e l’istruzione nella scuola primaria e secondaria (GU 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10-corr., 90/11, 5/12, 16/12, 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23 e 156/23) e in conformità al Regolamento sulle modalità e procedure di assunzione e ai sensi dell'articolo 7 del Regolamento interno per l'assunzione del personale della OŠ-SE “San Nicolò”, la direttrice della OŠ-SE “San Nicolò” di Fiume, Via Mirko Čurbeg 18, bandisce il C O N C O R S O per il posto di lavoro insegnante di classe al doposcuola in lingua italiana – orario completo, a tempo indeterminato – 2 persone, con la condizione del periodo di prova secondo il Contratto collettivo essenziale per gli ufficiali negli enti pubblici CONDIZIONI RICHIESTE: 1. Condizioni previste dagli articoli 105 e 106 della Legge sull'educazione e l'istruzione elementare e media superiore (GU 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10-corr., 90/11, 5/12, 16/12, 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23, 156/23), in conformità al Regolamento sulla qualificha e preparazione psico-pedagogica dei docenti e collaboratori nell'istruzione elementare (GU 6/19, 75/20) e secondo la Decisione sull'organizzazione e sullo svolgimento del doposcuola e della scuola a tempo pieno nelle scuole elementari della Città di Fiume (Gazzetta ufficiale della Città di Fiume n. 4 – anno XII): - laurea - padronanza della lingua e della scrittura italiana 2. Condizioni specifiche in base alla Legge sull'educazione e l'istruzione nella lingua e scrittura delle minoranze nazionali (GU 51/00, 56/00-corr.). Al Concorso possono partecipare i candidati di entrambi i sessi come previsto dall'articolo 13 della Legge sulle pari opportunità dei sessi (GU n. 82/16, 69/17). I termini usati in questo Bando di concorso si riferiscono a persone di entrambi i sessi. Le domande firmate devono essere corredate dalla seguente documentazione:
  • dati biografici (Curriculum vitae) redatti in lingua croata e in lingua italiana,
  • il Diploma di laurea, ovvero la prova attestante il grado d'istruzione e la qualifica professionale,
  • la prova di cittadinanza,
  • il Certificato/estratto digitale di dati dalla banca dati dell'HZMO e
  • l'attestato comprovante l'assenza di condanne penali considerate ostacoli per l'assunzione indicate nell'art. 106 della Legge sull'educazione e l'istruzione elementare e media superiore (con data di scadenza negli ultimi 6 mesi dalla data di pubblicazione del concorso).
La documentazione indicata deve pervenire all'indirizzo della scuola, spedita per posta raccomandata, entro e non oltre il termine di 8 giorni dalla pubblicazione del presente Bando di Concorso sul sito web della Scuola e sul sito web dell'Ufficio collocamento croato. I documenti vanno consegnati in copia non autenticata. I candidati che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nell'impiego, a parità di condizioni, in base a leggi specifiche, devono evocare questo diritto esplicitamente nella domanda e fornire in allegato oltre ai documenti comprovanti l'idoneità secondo i requisiti richesti, pure i documenti comprovanti lo status riconosciuto. Le persone di cui all'art.102 della Legge sui veterani della guerra patriottica croata e dei loro familiari (GU 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), art. 48. f della Legge sulla tutela degli invalidi di guerra militari e civili di (GU 33/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13, 98/19), art. 9 della Legge sulla riabilitazione professionale e l'impiego di persone disabili (GU 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20) e l'art. 48 della Legge sugli invalidi civili della guerra patriottica croata (GU 84/21, 13/26), dovranno comprovare il loro status con la documentazione indicata nella Legge speciale, che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nei confronti degli altri candidati esclusivamente alle stesse condizioni. I candidati che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nell'impiego secondo l'art. 102 della Legge sui veterani della guerra patriottica croata e dei loro familiari (GU 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), dovranno allegare anche le prove indicate nell'art. 103, comma 1 della Legge sui veterani della guerra patriottica croata e dei loro familiari, che si trova sul ipercollegamento-link del Ministero dei difensori: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/NG/12%20Prosinac/Zapo%C5%A1ljavanje/Popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju.pdf I candidati che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nell'impiego in base all'art. 48 della Legge sugli invalidi civili della guerra patriottica croata (GU 84/21, 13/26), dovranno indicare questo diritto ed allegare le prove indicate nell'art. 49, comma 1 della stessa Legge, indicate sul ipercollegamento-link del Ministero dei difensori: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf I candidati che hanno inoltrato le domande complete e tempestive e che soddisfano le condizioni formali del concorso partecipano nella procedura ulteriore e saranno invitati alla prova (test). La prova (test) include: test psicologici, verifiche della conoscenza della lingua italiana per coloro che non hanno finito almeno un ciclo di istruzione in lingua italiana, la stesura della lettera motivazionale ed il colloquio, tutto indicato ai sensi degli articoli 12 – 14 del Regolamento sulle modalità e sulla procedura di assunzione della OŠ-SE “San Nicolò”. Le domande incomplete e non pervenute entro il termine stabilito non verranno prese in considerazione. La Commissione che svolge le prove (test) per le assunzioni procederà secondo le regole stabilite dal Regolamento sulle modalità e procedure di assunzione dell'OŠ-SE »San Nicolò« con tutti i candidati che soddisferanno le condizioni formali richieste e che presenteranno domande complete, entro il termine previsto. Se il candidato non accede a una delle fasi della prova (test) si considererà come se avesse rinunciato alla procedura concorsuale ulteriore. Accedendo al Bando di concorso i candidati danno il proprio consenso all'elaborazione dei dati personali presenti in tutti i documenti allegati.
