title: Consultant BI (m/f)
description:
Dans le cadre du développement de nos activités SAP, Business Intelligence et Data, Bmatix recherche un(e) Consultant(e) SAP BI / Data Science & IA.

La particularité de ce profil réside à combiner de solides compétences dans l'écosystème SAP Business Intelligence avec des compétences en Data Science, Machine Learning et Intelligence Artificielle.

Vos missions :

En fonction des projets et des besoins de nos clients, vous pourrez intervenir sur différentes étapes de la chaîne Data :

SAP Business Intelligence

• Participer à la conception et à l'évolution de solutions BI dans l'environnement SAP.
• Intervenir sur SAP BW/4HANA et SAP BusinessObjects.
• Concevoir et maintenir des rapports et tableaux de bord avec SAP BusinessObjects Web Intelligence (WebI).
• Participer à la modélisation et à la structuration des données.
• Utiliser SAP Information Design Tool pour la conception et la gestion des univers.
• Analyser les besoins métiers et les traduire en solutions BI.
• Participer à l'amélioration et à l'optimisation des solutions de reporting existantes.

Data Engineering & ETL

• Participer à l'extraction, la transformation et l'intégration des données.
• Travailler sur des environnements SAP Data Services et SSIS.
• Manipuler différentes bases de données : MySQL et SQL Server.
• Préparer et nettoyer les données nécessaires aux analyses.
• Participer à la mise en place de flux de données fiables et exploitables.

Data Science & Machine Learning

• Explorer et analyser des jeux de données complexes.
• Préparer et transformer les données pour les modèles analytiques.
• Développer des modèles de Machine Learning.
• Participer à des travaux de prédiction, classification, régression et optimisation.
• Utiliser les bibliothèques Python dédiées à la Data Science et au Machine Learning.
• Évaluer les performances des modèles et interpréter les résultats.
• Explorer les possibilités offertes par l'Intelligence Artificielle dans les problématiques métiers de nos clients.

Data Analytics & Visualisation

• Réaliser des analyses statistiques et exploratoires.
• Identifier les tendances, corrélations et informations pertinentes dans les données.
• Construire des visualisations permettant de faciliter la compréhension et l'exploitation des données.
• Participer à la conception de tableaux de bord et d'indicateurs de performance.
• Utiliser Power BI ainsi que les outils de visualisation Python.

Votre profil :

Vous êtes diplômé(e) d'un Master en Data Science, Intelligence Artificielle, Business Intelligence, Informatique, Statistiques ou dans un domaine similaire.

Vous disposez d'une première expérience professionnelle significative dans les domaines de la BI, de la Data/ de l'IA.
Nous recherchons avant tout une personne capable de comprendre les problématiques métiers et de faire le lien entre données, outils BI et technologies Data/IA.

Au-delà de la maîtrise des différents outils, votre valeur ajoutée réside dans une double approche SAP BI et Data Science / IA.
Vous devez comprendre les problématiques traditionnelles de Business Intelligence et de reporting, tout en ayant une vision plus large des possibilités offertes par la Data Science, le Machine Learning et l'Intelligence Artificielle.

Find your purpose at KPMG Luxembourg

We see a world of opportunity. From uncovering ways to digitalize, to enabling new sectors to take off, to building sustainability and resilience into economies, we know insights reveal new opportunities for all.
We are diverse and dedicated problem solvers, part of the worldwide network of high-quality audit, tax and advisory services.

• Solid understanding of Luxembourg and international AML/CTF regulatory framework
• Strong interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to apply sound reasoning when delivering services to clients
• Strong attention to details, ability to manage teams and multiple priorities

What will you get

KPMG is where you will find the right opportunities to advance your career and the widest available range of possibilities so you can grow professionally. Make a real impact, join a diverse team of leading experts, work with global clients, and discover technological solutions.

Derzeit beschäftigen wir mehr als 1800 Mitarbeitende aus über 70 Nationen. Werde Teil unserer wachsenden Gemeinschaft junger und innovativer Mitglieder, um gemeinsam eine Welt voller Möglichkeiten zu erkunden.

Wir suchen unsere zukünftigen Junior-Auditoren (m/w/d) – Start im Oktober 2026

Wir sind im öffentlichen Interesse und für den Kapitalmarkt tätig, und wir haben uns verpflichtet, qualitativ hochwertige Prüfungen zu liefern, die durch die Kraft der Technologie und die Stärke unserer Mitarbeitenden ermöglicht werden. Durch den Einsatz führender Technologien verändern wir das Prüfungserlebnis für unsere Fachleute und unsere Kundschaft, wodurch wir eine noch höhere Prüfungsqualität bieten können, indem wir uns dank der Daten und Einblicke, die wir erhalten, noch besser auf die relevanten Themen konzentrieren können.

Deine Verantwortlichkeiten und Herausforderungen

• Erbringen von Prüfdienstleistungen für eine Vielzahl von Unternehmen und die Möglichkeit, deine Fähigkeiten in IFRS und lokalen GAAP zu entwickeln
• Teilnahme an Prüfungs- und Buchhaltungsprojekten für nationale und internationale Kundschaft in verschiedenen Branchen wie Banken, Versicherungen, Asset Management, Real Estate, Private Equity oder Commercial Industrial & Public Sector (CIPS; Handel und öffentlicher Sektor)
• Erwerb von fundierten Kenntnissen in den Bereichen Wirtschaftsprüfung, Finanz- und Rechnungswesen
• Vertrauen zur Kundschaft aufbauen und eine enge Beziehung mit ihnen pflegen
• Arbeiten in einem internationalen Umfeld, in dem die Unternehmenssprache Englisch ist
• Arbeiten in multikulturellen Teams mit Kolleg:innen aus verschiedenen Kulturen und Ländern

Woran du arbeiten wirst

Als Junior wirst du:

• Die Brücke zwischen deinem theoretischen Wissen und den praktischen Auswirkungen aufkommender globaler Rechnungslegungsstandards und internationaler Mandate überbrücken und eine profunde Beherrschung von Standards wie IFRS und lokalem GAAP entwickeln
• An einem vielfältigen Portfolio internationaler Kundschaft arbeiten und sie treffen (persönlich oder virtuell)
• Lernen, wie eine Vielzahl von Organisationen arbeiten, einschließlich der Überprüfung ihrer Systeme und Prozesse, um die Unternehmen, die du prüfen wirst, beraten zu können
• Vertrauen bei Berichtsadressat:innen schaffen, indem du die Jahresabschlüsse von Unternehmen prüfst
• Unsere Prüfungsmethodik umsetzen, die die Bewertung der Betriebsstruktur der Kundschaft, die Beurteilung von Risikofaktoren und internen Kontrollstrukturen, die Durchführung von Jahresabschlussprüfungen und die Formulierung gezielter Empfehlungen und spezialisierter Berichte beinhaltet
• Teil innovativer Projekte zur Verbesserung unserer Prozesse und digitaler Tools sein

Wonach wir suchen

Effektive Wirtschaftsprüfer:innen verfügen über eine Kombination aus technischen und sozialen Fähigkeiten, darunter:

• Qualifikation: Du hast einen Bachelor- oder Masterabschluss oder wirst dein Studium bald in den Bereichen Betriebswirtschaft, Volkswirtschaft, Wirtschaftsprüfung, Finanzen, Ingenieurwesen/IT oder Rechnungswesen abschließen oder du bist Betriebswirtin oder Fachwirtin und bist an einer beruflichen Qualifikation im Bereich Wirtschaftsprüfung interessiert (z. B. IRE, Wirtschaftsprüfer)
• Analytische Fähigkeiten: Die Fähigkeit, finanzielle Daten zu analysieren, Unregelmäßigkeiten zu identifizieren und die finanzielle Lage eines Unternehmens zu beurteilen
• Detailgenauigkeit: Ein geschultes Auge für Genauigkeit und die Verpflichtung zur gründlichen Dokumentation und Überprüfung
• Kommunikationsfähigkeiten: Effektive verbale und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, um ausgezeichnete Beziehungen zur Kundschaft und zu Teams aufzubauen und zu pflegen sowie die Fähigkeit, eigenständig und im Team zu arbeiten
• Ethische Integrität: Ein starkes Bekenntnis zu ethischem Verhalten und Unabhängigkeit, um die Glaubwürdigkeit des Prüfprozesses aufrechtzuerhalten
• Problemlösung: Die Fähigkeit, komplexe finanzielle Probleme und Unstimmigkeiten zu identifizieren und zu lösen
• Zeitmanagement: Effizientes Management mehrerer Mandate und Einhaltung von Fristen
• Sprachkenntnisse: Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und Englisch, jede weitere Sprache wäre von Vorteil

Was du erhalten wirst

Ergreife eine aufregende Gelegenheit, die Zukunft des globalen Geschäfts in Luxemburg zu gestalten, einem aufstrebenden Finanzzentrum. Bei KPMG sind wir bereit, dich auf einer Reise des beruflichen Wachstums zu begleiten und bieten dir ein breites Spektrum an Möglichkeiten, um deine Karriere zu fördern. KPMG bietet dir umfassende Schulungen und Unterstützung, einschließlich eines vollständigen Schulungsprogramms mit einer Einführungswoche im Ausland bei deiner Ankunft, um die Fähigkeiten zu erwerben, die du für deine beruflichen Ziele und deine berufliche Entwicklung benötigst. Im Rahmen der beruflichen Entwicklung bietet KPMG auch die Möglichkeit, interne oder externe Versetzungen durchzuführen, um in einer anderen Abteilung oder einem anderen Standort zu arbeiten.
Im Bereich der Prüfdienstleistungen wirst du eine spürbare Wirkung erzielen, indem du mit einer vielfältigen Gruppe von führenden Experten:innen zusammenarbeitest und mit einer weltweiten Kundschaft interagierst, während du innovative technologische Lösungen erkundest.

Als Teil der KPMG-Familie wirst du auch eine Reihe von Erlebnissen genießen, darunter die Teilnahme an Veranstaltungen wie KPMG Plage, dem Oktoberfest, der Betriebsfeier und anderen Festlichkeiten, die uns näher zusammenbringen. Schließe dich uns nicht nur für einen Job, sondern für eine bereichernde Reise an, profitiere von flexiblen Arbeitszeiten, der Möglichkeit, von zu Hause aus oder von verschiedenen Büros aus zu arbeiten, und einer umfassenden Schulung von Anfang an. Werde Teil eines vielfältigen Teams, in dem wir kontinuierlich die Geschlechtergleichstellung fördern und der LGBTQ+-Community kraftvolle Unterstützung bieten. Deine Erfolgsgeschichte beginnt hier. Schließe dich uns an und werde Teil von #Teamblue.

title: Technical Sales Support (m/f)
description:
À propos de Rotarex Firetec

Rotarex Firetec est une entreprise mondiale de référence dans le domaine des solutions d'extinction incendie, avec plusieurs millions d'installations à travers le monde.

Business Unit de Rotarex, Rotarex Firetec s'appuie sur un réseau international de centres de services et de distributeurs présents dans 65 pays.

Depuis plus de 100 ans, Rotarex Firetec développe des produits innovants qui sont devenus des références dans l'industrie. Notre expertise repose sur trois piliers essentiels : l'innovation, la qualité et l'excellence technique.


Localisation : Lintgen, Luxembourg

Le poste est actuellement basé sur notre site de Lintgen, au Luxembourg, avec un déménagement en cours vers notre nouveau site industriel 4.0 à Bissen, conçu pour offrir un environnement de travail moderne et pensé pour le confort de nos collaborateurs.


Votre mission

En tant que Support Technique Commercial, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans l'accompagnement de notre réseau commercial international et contribuerez au développement de nos activités dans le domaine des systèmes d'extinction incendie.

Vous apporterez votre expertise technique aux équipes commerciales et aux clients, les accompagnerez dans la conception et la sélection de solutions adaptées et assurerez le lien entre les équipes commerciales, les clients et les différents départements internes.


Vos missions seront les suivantes :

Support technique et accompagnement commercial

    Harmoniser les outils et les méthodes de support technique utilisés au sein du réseau commercial international

    Apporter un support technique avant et après-vente aux Sales Managers locaux et aux clients concernant la conception des systèmes, les spécifications techniques et les performances des solutions d'extinction incendie

    Mettre à jour et améliorer continuellement les configurateurs techniques

    Réaliser des présentations techniques et des démonstrations produits afin de renforcer la compréhension des clients et des équipes commerciales

    Accompagner les équipes commerciales dans le cadre des appels d'offres et des projets en préparant des réponses techniques détaillées et des solutions adaptées aux besoins des clients


Support clients et interventions terrain

    Agir en tant qu'interlocuteur technique pour les clients et accompagner la résolution de problématiques techniques complexes liées aux systèmes d'extinction incendie

    Effectuer des déplacements sur site afin d'apporter un support technique lors de l'installation, de la mise en service et de la maintenance des systèmes

    Développer et maintenir les ressources techniques nécessaires au support des équipes et des clients, notamment les guides de formation, benchmarks, spécifications systèmes, fiches techniques et FAQ

    Participer à la revue et à l'amélioration des manuels techniques et apporter un support aux équipes R&D lorsque nécessaire


Formation et transmission des connaissances

    Mettre à jour et maintenir les supports de formation, y compris les modules de formation en ligne

    Animer et superviser des formations techniques destinées aux clients et aux différents interlocuteurs du réseau commercial

    Émettre les certificats de formation et assurer le suivi des participants


Expertise réglementaire et connaissance du marché

    Assurer une veille sur les normes et évolutions réglementaires susceptibles d'impacter les systèmes d'extinction incendie

    Accompagner les équipes locales dans la compréhension des exigences réglementaires et des certifications applicables


Collaboration et amélioration continue

    Recueillir les retours des clients et des différents marchés afin d'identifier des opportunités d'amélioration des produits et des services

    Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes Marketing, Product Management et Sales afin de développer des contenus techniques destinés aux supports promotionnels et à l'information des clients


Votre profil

Formation et expérience

    Vous êtes titulaire d'un diplôme de niveau Bachelor en ingénierie, commerce ou dans un domaine connexe

    Vous disposez d'une expérience confirmée dans des fonctions de support technique et/ou de développement commercial, idéalement dans les secteurs de la sécurité incendie ou des équipements industriels

    Vous possédez de solides connaissances techniques des systèmes d'extinction incendie, des stations de remplissage de gaz ou de technologies similaires


⚙️ Compétences techniques et professionnelles

    Vous disposez d'une forte aptitude technique et êtes capable de comprendre et de résoudre efficacement des problématiques liées à des systèmes complexes

    Vous possédez une bonne compréhension des enjeux commerciaux et savez identifier des opportunités de développement

    Vous disposez d'excellentes compétences en communication et en présentation, ainsi que d'une réelle capacité à former différents types d'interlocuteurs

    Vous possédez d'excellentes qualités relationnelles et êtes capable de construire et d'entretenir des relations de confiance avec les clients

    Vous êtes organisé, rigoureux et capable de gérer plusieurs projets et échéances simultanément

    Vous maîtrisez les outils Microsoft Office et SAP


Langues et mobilité

    Vous maîtrisez parfaitement le français et l'anglais

    La connaissance d'autres langues constitue un atout

    Vous êtes disposé à effectuer des déplacements professionnels lorsque nécessaire


Ce que vous trouverez chez Rotarex

    La force d'un groupe industriel mondial alliée à une culture d'entreprise familiale

    De réelles opportunités de formation, de développement et d'évolution

    Des horaires flexibles selon le poste, favorisant l'équilibre entre vie professionnelle et vie personnelle

    De nombreux avantages sociaux, incluant des congés supplémentaires, des primes et un fonds social

    Un nouveau site industriel 4.0 à Bissen, offrant un environnement de travail ultramoderne avec notamment des cantines, une salle de sport, un parking gratuit, des bornes de recharge électriques et la climatisation

    Des avantages complémentaires tels que la carte Sympass et des partenariats préférentiels dans différents domaines, notamment la banque, l'assurance santé et les forfaits mobiles

    Des événements d'entreprise festifs favorisant la cohésion et l'esprit d'équipe

title: Head of Marketing and Communications (m/f/d)
description:
Head of Marketing and Communications (m/f/d)

Job Description

As Head of Marketing and Communications, you are accountable for shaping, amplifying, and protecting the firm's strategic priorities, growth agenda, and market positioning. Working closely with Executive Leadership, Business Development, and Sector Leads, you translate business strategy into compelling narratives, integrated go-to-market approaches, and high-impact marketing and communications activity.You lead the end-to-end marketing and communications agenda, spanning brand, reputation, digital, campaigns, events, internal communications, and employer branding. You explore and embed AI-enabled, insight-driven ways of working across all activities to deliver measurable commercial, reputational, and engagement impact.

AI is reshaping how clients discover expertise, consume content, engage with the firm, and make buying decisions, while also transforming the speed, skills, controls, and operating model required within Marketing and Communications. The role must therefore lead a deliberate shift in ways of working—redesigning processes rather than simply adding tools, strengthening data and content governance, building AI literacy and adoption across the team, and maintaining human judgement, creativity, brand integrity, and accountability.

This transformation must be closely connected to Business Development, sector priorities, and the firm's growth agenda, using AI and market insight to identify opportunities, sharpen propositions, personalise engagement, accelerate go-to-market activity, and improve pipeline conversion and commercial impact.

What you will be working on

Strategy, Planning & Leadership

• Translate business priorities into integrated marketing and communications plans.
• Partner with Business Development and Sector Leads to support growth, demand generation, and pipeline development.
• Drive governance, prioritization, and performance measurement across all marketing activities.
• Ensure consistent brand positioning, messaging, visual identity, and storytelling.

External Communications & Reputation

• Lead media relations, public relations, executive communications, and thought leadership.
• Support firm-wide initiatives and manage reputational risks.

Digital Marketing, Campaigns & Demand Generation

• Develop and execute digital, social media, and multi-channel marketing campaigns.
• Oversee SEO/SEM, paid media, marketing automation, and analytics.
• Use data and insights to optimize performance and commercial impact.

Events, Sponsorships & Partnerships

• Lead strategic events, sponsorships, memberships, and partnerships that enhance brand visibility and client engagement.

Internal Communications & Employer Brand

• Drive internal communications and employee engagement initiatives.
• Partner with HR to strengthen employer branding and talent attraction.
• Ensure alignment between employee experience and external reputation.

AI, Transformation & Operations

• Embed AI capabilities across marketing and communications to improve insight, creativity, efficiency, and effectiveness.
• Redesign processes and operating models to support AI-enabled ways of working.
• Ensure appropriate governance, quality control, compliance, and data protection.

Financial & People Leadership

• Own the marketing and communications budget and resource allocation.
• Lead, develop, and inspire a high-performing team.
• Build capabilities in digital marketing, analytics, AI, and storytelling.
• Manage agency and vendor relationships.

What we look for

• Significant leadership experience (minimum 15 years) across Marketing and Communications, ideally within professional services, financial services, or another complex, regulated, knowledge-led environment.
• Proven ability to translate business strategy into impactful marketing and communication plans.
• Strong executive presence with the ability to influence and advise senior stakeholders.
• Extensive experience in brand management, communications, content strategy, and storytelling.
• Strong expertise in digital marketing, campaigns, social media, SEO/SEM, marketing automation, and analytics.
• Commercial and data-driven mindset, with the ability to demonstrate business impact.Experience leading transformation, change management, and AI adoption initiatives.
• Knowledge of GDPR and communications compliance requirements.Proven people leadership skills with experience building high-performing teams and fostering collaboration.
• Native English level. Additional languages relevant to Luxembourg's international environment are an asset.

Skills and Experience

Strategic Leadership

• Proven ability to translate business strategy into measurable marketing and communications plans
• Strong executive presence with the ability to influence senior stakeholders

Brand and Creative Direction

• Deep experience in brand positioning, creative briefing, content strategy, and storytelling, constantly pushing for creative ways to push the brand while adhering to brand guidelines where necessary.

Digital Marketing and Analytics

• Hands-on expertise in SEO/SEM, paid media, marketing automation, social platforms, and analytics
• Strong data-driven mindset with the ability to connect activity to commercial impact

Operational Excellence

• Budget ownership, vendor and agency management, contract negotiation, and scalable process design

Regulatory Awareness

• Familiarity with GDPR and professional services compliance requirements

Leadership and Collaboration

• Proven people leadership, cross-functional collaboration, and change management capability

Job Description & Summary

Meet your future team

Join our People Process Outsourcing (PPO) team within Human Capital, where specialists support clients with payroll, immigration and HR administration through a secure digital platform tailored to Luxembourg requirements. You will work closely with payroll experts, HR specialists and international colleagues to deliver compliant and efficient people processes for local and cross-border workforces.
What your role will look like

As a Payroll & HR Administration Associate, you will contribute to the accurate delivery of payroll and HR administration services for a portfolio of clients. Your role helps organisations stay compliant with Luxembourg and international requirements while ensuring employees receive a reliable and seamless payroll experience.

Description du poste

Intitulé du poste
Senior Relationship Manager - Real Estate

Activités / Missions

Présente au Luxembourg depuis plus de 100 ans, la Banque de Luxembourg est un acteur financier incontournable de la place au service de clients privés, des entreprises luxembourgeoises et de clients professionnels issus des métiers de la gestion d'actifs. Certifiée B Corp depuis 2023, notre Banque s'engage à renforcer l'impact social, sociétal et environnemental de ses activités.

Envie d'accompagner et de financer les grands projets qui transforment le Luxembourg ?

Le pôle Immobilier de notre département Entreprises et Entrepreneurs accompagne les acteurs incontournables du secteur immobilier à Luxembourg en leur offrant des solutions de financement structurées et une expertise conseil de premier plan. Notre force ? Un ancrage local fort et une capacité à intervenir sur tous les métiers de l'immobilier.
Nous intervenons comme un véritable partenaire stratégique dans l'ensemble des activités de nos clients :
La promotion immobilière
L'investissement immobilier
La construction

En tant que Senior Relationship Manager - Real Estate, vous gérez de manière autonome un portefeuille de clients professionnels de l'immobilier et les accompagnez dans leurs projets et dans leurs besoins bancaires quotidiens.

• Vous étudiez les demandes de financement d'acteurs professionnels du secteur immobilier : vous analysez la faisabilité économique et financière de projets immobiliers et étudiez les rapports financiers ;
• Vous rédigez et structurez les demandes de crédits, proposez des solutions de financement en ligne avec l'appétit risque de la banque et défendez les dossiers devant les comités compétents ;
• Vous collaborez avec le département Crédit et Juridique afin de réaliser la documentation juridique et contractuelle relative au financement ;
• Vous assurez le suivi des opérations financées, veillez à une utilisation correcte des fonds et anticipez les risques éventuels ;
• Vous contribuez à la réalisation de crédits syndiqués (club deals) avec d'autres banques ;
• Vous développez et entretenez un réseau solide auprès des principaux acteurs de l'écosystème et représentez la banque à l'occasion d'évènements pour participer à son rayonnement ;
• Vous développez de nouvelles relations clients et identifiez des nouvelles opportunités pour atteindre vos objectifs commerciaux ;
• Vous assurez la revue périodique des engagements et vous veillez au respect des exigences de conformité des comptes (KYC, KYT, AML etc.)

Profil

De formation Bac+5 en sciences économiques, commerciales ou financières, vous avez au moins 10 ans d'expérience dans un établissement bancaire au Luxembourg avec une expérience de minimum 5 ans dans le domaine des financements immobiliers ;
• Vous disposez d'excellentes connaissances en matière de crédits, d'analyse bilantaire et financière, et vous maîtrisez les concepts de financement de projets ;
• Vous disposez d'une expérience avérée dans les financements syndiqués ou financements en club deal et êtes familiers avec les contrats LMA ;
• Vous justifiez de connaissances approfondies liées au marché et aux technicités de l'immobilier au Luxembourg et connaissez les principaux acteurs locaux ;
• Vous disposez d'une proactivité et d'une autonomie forte et êtes orientés résultat ;
• Votre aisance relationnelle, votre sens de la négociation couplée à votre orientation client et à votre engagement professionnel font de vous un interlocuteur apprécié, capable d'établir une relation privilégiée avec les clients ;
• Rigoureux·euse, flexible et organisé·e, vous êtes également doté·e d'excellentes capacités d'analyse et de synthèse et de bonnes aptitudes rédactionnelles ;
• Vous parlez couramment le français et l'anglais, la maîtrise du luxembourgeois et/ou de l'allemand constitue un avantage.

Convaincus que notre diversité fait notre force, nous sommes signataires de la Charte de la Diversité, Lëtzebuerg. Attentifs à l'égalité des chances, nous nous engageons à travers des actions concrètes, notamment en faveur des jeunes talents, des femmes, des collaborateurs seniors…

Vous souhaitez …

• rejoindre des équipes composées de femmes et d'hommes d'horizons multiples, aux parcours et compétences complémentaires ,
• vous développer dans un cadre de travail respectant l'équilibre vie privée-vie professionnelle ;
• évoluer dans un environnement propice à l'épanouissement de tous les talents…

Adressez-nous votre CV accompagné d'une lettre de motivation via notre Espace Candidats.

Pour information, un extrait du casier judiciaire de moins de 2 mois vous sera demandé avant la conclusion de tout contrat de travail.

Our dynamic international team of 450+ experienced wealth structuring specialists, subject-matter and technical experts consists of 50 different nationalities, speaking over 30 languages.

We invest in talented teams who develop their expertise, curated through support and training, and fostered through a people centred culture. Our people truly are our greatest asset!

Your role - Are you ready for a challenge?

Following an end-to-end Client due diligence review the primary role of the team is to clear any gaps while improving quality and achieving compliance with current and future regulatory standards.

Your responsibilities will be as follows:

• Act as the person of contact for partner and client queries received by email, post or by telephone in respect of client data management,
• Take the necessary action to respond in an effective, professional and timely manner to the queries received by telephone, email or post from partners, clients or sales colleagues consistently ensuring a high level of service,
• Perform accurate and timely processing of the receipt of client data and query resolution relating to the management of client data, including document management, review of information and update of our Data Management system,
• Assist in processing the due diligence review of transactions in line with corporate and regulatory standards,
• Assist in contacting Partners and Clients to collect up to date data information and document collected through the KYC process,
• Assist in contacting clients using mass mailing and other client outreaching tool,
• Assist in communicating to Partner and Client on corporate initiatives,
• Develop and maintain a strong working relationship with our sales consultants and all partners,
• Maintain an ongoing awareness of services, review procedures and ensure quality improvements are made as required.

Your profile – Have you got what it takes to become our KYC Officer?

• A minimum of 2 years experience working within the financial/insurance sector,
• Aware of developments within the financial/insurance sector in general,
• Knowledge of Compliance and AML regulation in the Life insurance sector,
• Experience in AML/KYC remediation or with client due diligence,
• You enjoy working in a challenging, fast paced environment and look for the opportunity to excel in all aspects of your role;
• Take personal pride in delivering high quality service to internal and external clients,
• Strong prioritisation skills and flexible, reliable and responsible in challenging situations,
• A team player with excellent interpersonal, customer service and communication skills (verbal and written) with active listening skills,
• Ability to work independently while keen to work as part of a team and assist colleagues,
• Ability to demonstrate a high level of initiative and problem-solving capabilities,
• You will be self-motivated with a high level of attention to detail, ability to understand client requirements and to develop relevant solutions,
• Willing to make the extra effort as required,
• Fluency in English is required. Spanish, Dutch, French, and Portuguese ae considered an advantage.

As an equal opportunity employer, all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, colour, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

description:
Fixed term contract | Belvaux | 48 months

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.

The Environmental Sustainability Assessment and Circularity (SUSTAIN) Unit conducts cross disciplinary research to support the transition toward a more sustainable, resilient, and healthy society. SUSTAIN combines expertise in environmental sciences, circular economy, risk and safety assessment, and sustainable innovation to address complex challenges related to human and environmental health, climate change, and resource efficiency, developing knowledge, methods, and transferable software for the simulation and comprehensive sustainability assessment of socio-economic systems. Its purpose is to foster sustainable eco-innovation, through products and technologies, as well as support sustainability-oriented policy implementation and behavioural change to promote decarbonisation transitions.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?

The world faces a convergence of crises that are transforming the conditions for human development. Climate instability, ecosystem degradation, and the overuse of natural resources have reached critical levels, while social inequality, political fragmentation, and technological disruption are reshaping societies. Traditional notions of economic competitiveness, centred on growth and productivity, are being redefined to include social resilience, inclusiveness, and ecological integrity. Responding to this “polycrisis” requires new pathways that reconcile prosperity with planetary and social limits. Luxembourg offers a particularly illustrative example of these tensions. The country enjoys one of the highest income levels globally and a dynamic financial and business environment that sustains its reputation for economic success. Yet this prosperity depends strongly on cross-border commuting, which creates mobility challenges and environmental stress. Escalating housing prices have made access to affordable living increasingly difficult, displacing a significant share of the workforce beyond national borders. The reliance on imported energy leaves households and firms vulnerable to external shocks. Although Luxembourg's welfare model and social dialogue remain robust, they are under pressure from rising costs of living, widening inequalities, and growing demands on public services. Environmentally, Luxembourg's footprint per inhabitant ranks among the largest worldwide, driven by high consumption and land-use pressures that push the country beyond sustainable limits.

Meeting these intertwined challenges calls for coordinated transformations that bridge sectors, disciplines, and scales. Economic and social progress must be reframed within the concept of a Safe Operating Space—an area in which human well-being is achieved without breaching environmental boundaries. The objective is to steer innovation, governance, and everyday practices toward forms of competitiveness that are compatible with sustainability, rather than in conflict with it. The Doctoral Training Unit C-SOS (Competitiveness within a Safe Operating Space) is designed to cultivate researchers capable of analysing and fostering such transformations. It brings together an interdisciplinary consortium to train 12 PhD candidates in the assessment and design of inclusive and sustainable development trajectories. The programme equips them with conceptual and methodological tools to connect environmental sustainability, social well-being, and economic dynamics into integrated frameworks for decision-making. Its ambition is to inform socio-economic policies, encourage responsible industrial and technological innovation, and contribute to more equitable and resilient societies. Luxembourg provides an ideal environment for this initiative, combining strong expertise in sustainability science and policy analysis. The DTU is a collaboration between researchers at the Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST), the University of Luxembourg (UL) and the Urban Development and Mobility Department at the Luxembourg Institute of Socio-Economic Research (LISER). The consortium also includes the National Statistics Office (STATEC). In this DTU, 12 scientists will train 12 PhD students over six years (from January 2027), each obtaining a PhD from UL's doctoral schools.

As part of the C-SOS Doctoral Training Unit, in this PhD you will integrate concepts from Post-Growth, Sufficiency and Doughnut Economics into the downscaling of planetary boundaries, leveraging good examples of application to territories and cities. Possible research questions include: how to couple ecological limits and social foundation as an interdependent system? How to define social foundation? How to allocate the carrying capacity based on social foundation?.

You will be embedded in the SUSTAIN unit at LIST and enrolled as a doctoral candidate at the University of Luxembourg. You will work closely with a diverse cohort of 12 PhD researchers across the social, economic, and environmental sciences, contributing to a shared research agenda on how Luxembourg can thrive within its fair share of planetary limits

You will be mainly in charge of:
• Conducting a systematic review and critical assessment of existing carrying capacity allocation and planetary boundary downscaling approaches, spanning economic and emission based allocation methods, sufficiency based approaches, and Doughnut Economics frameworks
• Developing a methodological framework for coupling ecological limits and social foundation as an interdependent system, integrating Post-Growth, Sufficiency, and Doughnut Economics concepts into the downscaling of planetary boundaries
• Applying the framework to Luxembourg and comparable small territories under a range of allocation scenarios, drawing on Green Deal technology targets, context specific Decent Living Standards, and provisioning systems, producing environmental ceiling estimates grounded in social foundation thresholds
• Building and maintaining a dynamic system model enabling the testing of individual and combined allocation approaches, valuing social outcome generation per unit of environmental impact across relevant planetary boundary dimensions
• Collaborating with other C-SOS doctoral researchers, in particular those working on social foundation, Quality of Life, and economic systems, to ensure that allocation approaches rest on socially realistic and empirically coherent definitions of social foundation
• Publishing results in peer reviewed journals and presenting at international conferences
• Contributing to C-SOS training activities, workshops, and stakeholder engagement events

Education

• Solid academic grounding in Planetary Boundaries, Doughnut Economics, Post Growth or degrowth literature
• Familiarity with Decent Living Standards and Quality of Life frameworks

title: RESEARCHER IN FIRST-PRINCIPLES MODELLING OF MULTIFERROIC MATERIALS (m/f)
employer: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology - LIST
description:
Fixed term contract | Belvaux | 24 months

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?

The push to reduce global energy consumption has set a clear trend in modern technology towards devices that are smaller, faster and more energy-efficient. Meeting these demands calls for new materials that can perform several functions at once. Magnetoelectric multiferroics are especially attractive in this respect, because they combine magnetism and ferroelectricity in a single phase. Crucially, this opens the possibility of controlling magnetism with an electric field which could enable entirely new device architectures and transform modern computing and data storage. Despite decades of progress, this promise is hard to realise: in most known multiferroics the two orders only coexist well below room temperature, and many are difficult to integrate with standard semiconductor manufacturing. Turning multiferroics into a practical technology therefore requires identifying or designing new materials that show robust, coupled magnetism and ferroelectricity at room temperature and remain compatible with established fabrication processes.

This is the challenge at the heart of the SMART project funded by the FNR CORE programme and led by Natalya Fedorova. We offer a 2-year postdoc position in which you will use first-principles calculations (DFT) together with analytical modelling to design room-temperature multiferroics via doping of semiconductors. Working mainly with DFT, you will carry out a systematic analysis of electronic, structural, magnetic and ferroelectric properties of these materials - computing, for instance, ground-state magnetic configurations, magnetic exchange interactions, electric polarization and polarization-switching pathways. You will then combine these results with analytical models to describe the magnetoelectric coupling in the most promising candidates and to explore how their magnetism could be manipulated with an applied electric field.

You will join the Modelling of Functional Materials group led by Jorge Íñiguez-González (also involved in the project) and will benefit from interactions with other team members.

Code Development (60%):

·          Implement chunking strategies optimised for fund accounting reports and regulatory circulars, preserving the structure of calculation tables, formula references, and numbered regulatory provisions.
·          Build evaluation frameworks measuring control accuracy (error detection rate, false positive/negative rates on flagged discrepancies) and the quality of generated audit reports
·          Optimise vector database indexing for regulatory document corpora with high update frequency, ensuring fast retrieval as new CSSF/ESMA guidance is published

Research & experimentation (25%):
·          Benchmark embedding models against the current Nomic Embed Text baseline, with a focus on sensitivity to numerical and regulatory language in fund accounting contexts
·          Explore cross-lingual retrieval for EU regulatory documents published across multiple languages, with emphasis on French and German variants of CSSF and ESMA guidance
·          Research agent-based simulation of NAV calculation steps, investigating how LLMs can reason reliably over arithmetic-sensitive regulatory workflows and signal confidence levels
·          Experiment with multi-agent orchestration for second-level control workflows, where agents decompose a NAV control task into parallel verification sub-tasks across pricing, accruals, and corporate actions.

System integration (15%):
·          Integrate LLM backends optimised for structured reasoning and develop prompt engineering patterns that enforce step-by-step calculation verification and explainable output
·          Implement comprehensive logging, structured audit trail generation, and monitoring dashboards that allow compliance officers to review and challenge control decisions

title: PHD IN SPIN PHOTON ENTANGLEMENT GENERATION WITH COLOUR CENTRES IN SILICON CARBIDE (m/f)

description:
PHD IN SPIN PHOTON ENTANGLEMENT GENERATION WITH COLOUR CENTRES IN SILICON CARBIDE (m/f)

Temporary contract | 14+22(+12) months | Belval

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us
The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a Research and Technology Organization (RTO) active in the fields of materials, environment and IT. By transforming scientific knowledge into technologies, smart data and tools, LIST empowers citizens in their choices, public authorities in their decisions and businesses in their strategies.
Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?
You will be part of the LIST Materials Research and Technology department, where you will carry out your work in the Quantum Materials Group, led by Dr. Florian Kaiser.
Quantum technologies have the potential to revolutionise the world in many aspects. Quantum colour centres in in wide bandgap semiconductors have recently emerged as a promising platform, since they can incorporate quantum systems, which can be scaled up by industrial processing. Along these lines, we have recently shown that individual colour centres can be integrated into silicon carbide nanophotonic waveguides with little-to-no degradation of spin-optical coherences. These finding define the strategy for developing a scalable quantum technology architecture.
Our strategy is to use multiplexed and integrated colour centres for quantum communication tasks. Key here is to generate entanglement between colour centres based on spin-photon entanglement, as well as Hong-Ou-Mandel interference. With this milestone demonstration, we strive to kickstart subsequent developments towards a quantum internet architecture.

The objective of this PhD thesis is to support our work towards optical interference between colour centres, i.e., Hong-Ou-Mandel interference. The initial part of this thesis comprises setting up our new optical cryostat platform, which is based on a combination of standard confocal microscopy, and interferometry. In the second step, you will benefit from our ongoing activities towards quantum photonic silicon carbide chips in which we generate colour centres in fibre-coupled waveguides.
You will determine the ideal pulsed excitation schemes for colour centres, considering spectral, temporal and polarization filtering. Subsequently, you will characterise the photon quality depending on experimental parameters, and implement initial two-photon inteference experiments outside of the cryostat, followed by a fully-on-chip demonstration inside the cryostat. If time permits, this project can be further extended to the generation of entanglement between two colour centre chips located in two different cryostats.

How will you contribute?

LIST is seeking to recruit a two-year postdoctoral position to work on fabrication of the piezoelectric energy harvester based on ceramics for tires. This position is part of the Strategic Research Program “Tire as a sensor” in the joint project with Goodyear SA and explores how to transform mechanical energy from tires to a useful electrical energy, which can power tire sensors. The approach used for energy harvesting is the piezoelectric effect. Materials which show piezoelectric properties transform strain variation into electrical charge. These materials can be ceramics or polymers. The material chosen in this study is commercial PZT ceramics. To efficiently use the available mechanical energy in tires and induce strain in the piezoelectric material, it is essential to develop an adapted harvester's design, the transducer. In addition, harvester's signal conditioning plays an important role. To harvest enough electrical energy, all three points: material properties, harvester design and signal conditioning, have to be addressed.

This Postdoc position is mainly focused on development of energy harvester based on ceramics. Several challenges will be addressed to achieve targeted values of power from tires:
·        Investigation of geometries for an efficient transfer of strain from the tire into the ceramic. The design optimisation will be done using finite element modelling (Comsol)
·        Development/adaptation of signal conditioning electronics
·        Integration of the harvester into a real tire
·        Tests in the tire in operation

title: HR BUSINESS PARTNER (m/f)
employer: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology - LIST
description:
HR-26001 HR BUSINESS PARTNER

Permanent contract | Belval

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO), bridging scientific excellence and applied research to address real-world challenges. With over 840 employees - more than 70% of whom are researchers, engineers, and PhD-level professionals working across Natural & Built Environments, Industrial Technologies, Space, AI, Security and Defence.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website.

How will you contribute?

Our HR team of 20 professionals covers the full spectrum: HR Administration, Talent Acquisition, Learning and Development, HR Projects, and HR Business Partnering. This last function currently comprises two HRBPs. Following continued organisational growth and increasing complexity, we are creating a third HRBP position - not to replace someone, but because the demand is real.

The role

The HR Business Partner operates with a high degree of autonomy under the general supervision of the HR Director.
This is an individual contributor (IC) role - you will not manage a team, but you will lead by influence, advise with authority, and build lasting relationships within a public research institution.
You will be the primary HR point of contact for a defined population of managers and employees (e.g. Head of Units, Group Leaders, Service Heads), supporting them across the full employment lifecycle — from recruitment validation to exit interviews, from salary review to contractual management. You will work side-by-side with HR Admin, Talent Acquisition, and L&D, but the accountability for your internal "client" perimeter is yours.
This is not a role where you execute a playbook. It is a role where you read the situation, navigate the rules, and find the right path - always within a well-defined legal and regulatory framework.

What you will actually do

Here is what you will spend your time on:

1. Conflict Management & Difficult Situation Advisory

This is the most demanding dimension of the role - not in volume, but in complexity, emotional weight, and reputational stakes. Your approach is fundamentally advisory: you coach managers on how to prevent tensions from escalating, and when a situation has already become critical, you guide them through a structured, legally sound resolution process. You distinguish between what requires immediate intervention and what requires patience. You document carefully, advise precisely, and remain steady when those around you are not. Working with highly educated, articulate professionals means that the people on both sides of a conflict are often skilled at constructing their argument - your job is to remain the clearest, calmest voice in the room.

2. Manager Coaching

You act as a trusted sounding board for managers navigating team dynamics, people decisions, and leadership challenges. This is not change management in the programme-delivery sense - it is the daily, relational work of helping managers think through situations, anticipate consequences, and gradually build their own HR reflex. You build your influence over time, not through authority, but through consistency, credibility, and genuine availability.

3. Recruitment Facilitation & Internal Mobility

You are the HRBP anchor in the recruitment process for your perimeter: framing needs with Hiring Managers, contributing to the annual recruitment plan, and supporting internal mobility decisions. You do not own the end-to-end recruitment process - that is the Talent Acquisition team's remit - but you ensure the right organisational decisions are made at the right moments.

4. Trial Period & Contract Monitoring

You actively track trial periods, flag risks early, and organise structured feedback conversations between managers and employees. You manage end-of-trial-period decisions with rigor and care. You conduct or facilitate exit interviews and ensure that what can be learned is captured. You have a genuine appetite for contractual matters - including the nuances of employment situation.

5. Luxembourg Employment Law - Applied Advisory

You are a reliable reference point on Luxembourg labour law and its practical application: CNS procedures (reclassement, medical visits), parental and family leave frameworks, absence management processes, and dismissal procedures. You do not just cite the rule - you contextualise it, assess the risk level, and give the manager and HRD actionable guidance, always within the legal and regulatory framework.

6. Annual Salary Review

You coordinate and manage the annual salary review cycle for your client perimeter, ensuring internal equity, policy compliance, and a smooth process across managers, HR Admin, and Finance. You are comfortable working with data - building and maintaining Excel dashboards, producing pivot-table-based analyses, and transforming raw data into clear decision-support materials for management. Advisory skills.

7. Performance Management Support

You oversee the annual appraisal cycle and provide advisory support to managers on objective-setting and performance conversations, ensuring process consistency - while remaining in an advisory capacity rather than a direct participant in those discussions.

8. HR Department Contribution

You contribute to collective HR objectives, participate in cross-functional initiatives, and actively represent the HR team's values in every interaction with your internal clients. You communicate through influence - not authority - and you understand that in a public institution, relationships are built slowly and lost quickly.

The Environment

We want you to know what you are signing up for:

Your internal clients are highly educated. Many are PhD-level professionals who are rigorous, analytical, and used to evidence-based reasoning. Vague HR advice will not land. You must be precise, credible, and consistent.
This is a public research institution. That brings strengths - stability, mission-driven colleagues, and genuine intellectual depth - as well as challenges: governance layers and decision cycles that differ from those in smaller organizations.
Flexibility is key. LIST operates across multiple research domains with matrix-like reporting lines and evolving team structures. You will frequently need to act without the full picture being settled.
The tooling is pragmatic, not perfect. Office 365 is your daily environment.
Proactive, not reactive. The best HRBPs here anticipate - they may notice a manager struggling before it becomes a case, they flag a contractual risk before it becomes a dispute. Structured foresight is expected.
You will need to be visible. Open-space team, occasional presence across LIST sites. Being accessible and visible matters here.

Is Your profile described below? Are you our future colleague? Apply now!

Must-haves

At least 5 years of HR experience after Bachelor's degree or 3 years after Master's degree in Human Resources, with a substantial portion in a generalist HRBP or HR advisory role - you have operated independently, ideally not as support to a more senior HRBP
Proven conflict management and employee relations expertise - you have coached managers through difficult situations, both preventively and curatively, from first signal to resolution
Solid knowledge of Luxembourg employment law in practice (CNS, absences, dismissals, parental leave, etc).
Genuine appetite for contractual matters - you find contract drafting, amendment, and employment nuances interesting, not burdensome
Excel proficiency at pivot-table level minimum - you can produce clean, decision-ready reporting and work with compensation or absence data without requiring handholding
Fluency in both English and French (written and spoken) - both languages are in daily use

WeForming and EnerTEF focus on the use of Inverter-Based Resources (IBRs) in smart grids. Specifically, this project leverages industrial communication networks, distributed controllers, AI models, and state-of-the-art IBR-based infrastructure to optimize EV charging and energy systems. By integrating distributed energy resources, demand response, and storage, this project aims to enhance grid flexibility and increase the use of renewable energy.

title: Service Desk Agent - (CDI) (m/f)
employer: Mitsubishi UFJ Investor Services & Banking (Luxembourg) S.A.
description:
Tasks and Responsibilities:

Under the supervision of your hierarchical line, you are in charge of the following functions:

• Assure appropriate first-level assistance and timely support to MIBL staff for IT-related incidents, service requests and user issues;
• Provide first-level troubleshooting and resolution for common hardware, software, network, access and workplace IT issues;
• Assure efficient and professional follow-up on Level 1 support activities, ensuring incidents and requests are properly logged, categorized, prioritized and tracked;
• Maintain accurate and up-to-date Service Desk knowledge articles, manuals, support procedures and troubleshooting documentation covering the Bank's IT environment and standard applications;
• Assist in the onboarding, offboarding and modification of user accounts, access rights and IT equipment in accordance with established procedures and security requirements
• Provide appropriate support for the installation, configuration and basic maintenance of standard IT software and hardware equipment within the MIBL premises;
• Ensure proper communication with users regarding the status, progress and resolution of their incidents and service requests;
• Provide first-level support and appropriate escalation during Public Banking Holidays;
• Perform basic monitoring and operational checks of IT services and systems as defined in Level 1 procedures, and promptly escalate any anomalies to Level 2 support;
• Escalate unresolved or complex incidents and service requests to Level 2 support or other appropriate IT teams, ensuring that all relevant troubleshooting information and actions already performed are properly documented;
• Immediately report suspected IT security incidents, phishing attempts, malware, unauthorized access or other security concerns to the appropriate IT/Information Security contact;


Your Profile:

• Good knowledge of Windows, Microsoft 365 and standard end-user applications;
• Good knowledge of PC hardware, peripherals and basic network troubleshooting;
• Good knowledge of Active Directory and basic user/access management;
• Good knowledge of ITIL / IT Service Management and ITSM ticketing tools;
• Good knowledge of basic IT security principles;
• Good knowledge of Banking applications and IT support procedures;

Salary Range: 58k – 61k


Please be aware that in accordance with the law of July 23rd, 2016 the selected candidate will be requested to provide a criminal record (section 3).

description:

You will lead sourcing, supplier selection and commercial negotiations, including contracts and pricing, to support Vodafone's global strategy and customer solutions.

You will also support the Sales team in winning Vodafone Business customer bids, linking procurement activity directly to revenue growth, margin and customer experience.

Lead supplier selection and commercial strategy

Develop and execute sourcing and negotiation strategies to deliver cost efficiencies and value creation.
Lead supplier selection for customer bids and shape competitive commercial propositions.
Align business requirements with Vodafone's global category strategies.
Drive end-to-end supplier lifecycle management

Manage supplier relationships across the full contract lifecycle.
Ensure contractual compliance, performance management and risk mitigation.
Monitor supplier KPIs and minimise value leakage through robust contract management.
Act as a strategic business partner

Serve as the key interface between SCM and Vodafone Business stakeholders.
Build strong, credible relationships with internal functions and account teams.
Influence demand, challenge requirements and drive demand management excellence.
Contribute to category strategy and market insight

Support global category strategies, sourcing decisions and supplier roadmaps.
Provide insight on market dynamics, supplier ecosystems and commercial models.
Contribute to product, partner and alliance roadmaps.
Support revenue growth and customer delivery

Enable successful customer bids through strong supplier propositions.
Support delivery of global enterprise solutions with compliant and competitive supplier contracts.
Ensure alignment with revenue growth, customer experience and margin objectives.
Leverage tools, governance and innovation

Use BI and procurement tools, such as SAP and AVA, to identify opportunities and track performance.
Apply Design-to-Cost and global sourcing initiatives.
Drive SCM governance, programme assurance and benefits tracking.
Work agile and collaboratively

Operate across a global matrix organisation.
Lead and participate in cross-functional and cross-category initiatives.
Collaborate effectively across regions using digital tools.
Core Competencies

Business Partnering: Build strong stakeholder relationships to drive performance and value
Commercial Contract Management: Protect Vodafone's interests and ensure contractual value delivery
Demand Optimisation: Analyse and influence demand in line with strategy and budgets
Procurement Negotiation: Deliver optimal outcomes through effective negotiation
Market Insight & Strategy: Apply industry knowledge to support sourcing and category strategy
You must have

Bachelor's and/or Engineering degree
Minimum of 3 years' procurement experience
Strong communication, analytical and conceptual thinking skills

Ability to prioritise and execute tasks in a high-pressure environment
Flexibility to manage varied projects, tasks and ambiguity
Excellent written and spoken English

Niveau d'étude demandé egal Bachelor (Bac +3)

Bachelor of Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering
Masters in Management - Business Management

title: Supply Chain Environment Specialist (m/f)
description:
At Vodafone, we're working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this.

We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.

With us, you can be truly be yourself and belong, share inspiration, embrace new opportunities, thrive, and make a real difference.
Join Us

At Vodafone, we're not just shaping the future of connectivity for our customers – we're shaping the future for everyone who joins our team. When you work with us, you're part of a global mission to connect people, solve complex challenges, and create a sustainable and more inclusive world. If you want to grow your career whilst finding the perfect balance between work and life, Vodafone offers the opportunities to help you belong and make a real impact.
What you'll do

The Supply Chain Environmental Specialist supports the development and delivery of Vodafone's environmental strategy across supply chain categories and markets. The role focuses on category-level climate transition planning, supplier engagement, emissions reduction, and capability building within procurement, ensuring purchased goods and services align with Vodafone's 2030 reduction milestones and 2040 Net Zero ambition.
The role sits within Vodafone Procure & Connect (VP&C) in Luxembourg and reports into Vodafone Group's Sustainable Business Team, which sets global sustainability strategy and partners with business units to drive delivery. This is a growing and high-impact area, offering the opportunity to work with sustainability and supply chain experts while engaging a wide range of stakeholders across markets and functions. The role requires a self-driven individual with strong communication and programme management skills, comfortable creating new ways of working.

1. Category climate transition strategies

Support the development of category-specific climate transition plans aligned to Net Zero 2040.
Conduct baseline assessments to identify emissions hotspots, risks, opportunities, and KPIs.
Embed environmental criteria into category planning to support long-term decarbonisation.

2. Procurement collaboration & decision-making support

Support the implementation of sustainable procurement processes, including environmental requirements and contract terms.
Partner with category managers to embed carbon reduction targets, environmental KPIs, and climate-aligned supplier selection.
Provide climate data, insights, and analysis to support responsible sourcing decisions.
Support ESG assessments within RFQs, guiding suppliers and integrating results into scoring models.

3. Supplier engagement & performance management

Manage supplier performance against ESG contractual commitments and KPIs.
Drive supplier alignment with Vodafone's environmental targets, reporting, and transition pathways.
Issue and track supplier improvement plans, escalating risks where required.
Participate in supplier reviews to support credible decarbonisation and improved environmental performance.

4. Capability building for procurement teams

Deliver training, tools, and guidance to strengthen environmental capability across procurement.
Develop templates, guidance, and onboarding materials covering KPIs, carbon methodologies, and assessments.
Facilitate workshops and learning sessions to embed sustainability into BAU procurement activities.

5. Environmental data, reporting & governance

Support consolidation and validation of supplier climate data for category strategies, CSRD, and internal reporting.
Maintain category-level environmental KPIs and provide progress updates to leadership.
Provide accurate and timely supply chain environmental data to Group Finance.
Who you are

    Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Procurement, Business, Logistics, Sustainability, or a related field. A Master's degree is an advantage.
    4+ years of experience in supply chain, procurement, sourcing, supplier management, logistics, or a related discipline, with exposure to complex stakeholder environments and cross-functional collaboration.
    Strong project management and analytical skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, interpret complex data sets, identify risks, and drive informed decision-making.
    Experience engaging and influencing suppliers and internal stakeholders, including Procurement, Finance, Operations, and Sustainability teams, to deliver business and sustainability objectives.
    Demonstrated ability to support supplier negotiations, supplier performance management, and risk mitigation initiatives, leveraging data-driven insights to improve outcomes.
    Strong understanding of procurement processes, category management, sourcing strategies, contract compliance, and supplier engagement practices.
    Proven track record of identifying and implementing process improvements, standardisation initiatives, and operational efficiencies within supply chain or procurement functions.
    Proactive, collaborative, and highly detail-oriented approach to problem-solving, with the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.
    Knowledge of supply chain sustainability principles, including circular economy, reverse logistics, responsible sourcing, ESG considerations, and supplier sustainability programmes.
    Passion for environmental sustainability, climate transition, Scope 3 emissions reduction, supplier ESG performance management, and circularity initiatives.
    Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and data analysis tools. Experience with ERP/MRP systems, reporting tools, and process automation is highly desirable.

Not a perfect fit?

Worried that you don't meet all the desired criteria exactly? At Vodafone we are passionate about empowering people and creating a workplace where everyone can thrive, whatever their personal or professional background. If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align exactly with every part of the job description, we encourage you to still apply as you may be the right candidate for this role or another opportunity.
What's in it for you

We want you to feel happy and fulfilled at work, without compromising the other things in life that matter to you. Here are some of the ways we support this:
Annual Discretionary Bonus
•    Rewarding your hard work and dedication
Generous Annual Leave
•    28 days of annual leave, with the option to buy an additional 5 days and the opportunity to carry over 5 days per year
•    1 additional day (Family Day) for personal milestones or special occasions
•    11 public holidays to enjoy time with family and friends
•    5 charity days per year to give back to the community
Flexible Work Arrangements
•    Flexible working schedule to help you balance your professional and personal life
•    20 days to work from abroad, allowing you to combine work with travel and new experiences
Comprehensive Health and Wellness
•    Lunch vouchers to support your midday meals
•    Access to private AXA health insurance and a robust pension scheme to secure your health and future
Continuous Learning and Development
•    Access to Vodafone University and online training resources to help you grow your skills and advance your career

title: Kundeservice søges til Malta - Betalt relokation
description:
Kundeservice søges til Malta – God løn, bonus og relocation-pakke

Kunne du tænke dig at kombinere en international karriere med livet på Malta?

Vi søger lige nu en dansktalende Kundeservice til en langsigtet stilling hos en international bank på Malta.

Du bliver en del af et professionelt team, hvor du arbejder med danske kunder og får mulighed for at udvikle dine kompetencer inden for kundeservice, salg og den finansielle sektor.

Stillingen er særligt interessant for dig, der allerede har erfaring med kundeservice eller salg – og måske har erfaring som Team Leader eller med KPI'er og dataanalyse.

OM JOBBET

Som Kundeservice bliver du en del af et team, der håndterer kundeservice, onboarding, salg og betalinger.

Du vil blandt andet:

• Besvare kundehenvendelser via telefon, live chat, email og SMS

• Hjælpe kunder med information om bankens produkter, services og betalinger

• Håndtere spørgsmål og henvendelser fra danske kunder

• Arbejde tæt sammen med betalings- og collectionsafdelingen

• Følge gældende procedurer, regler og lovgivning

• Arbejde med salg og aktivt identificere relevante salgsmuligheder

• Sikre en professionel og effektiv kundeoplevelse

Du refererer direkte til den danske Team Leader og bliver en del af et internationalt arbejdsmiljø.

HVORFOR MALTA?

Malta er en populær destination for danskere, der ønsker at kombinere arbejde med livet i udlandet.

Her får du mulighed for at bo på en middelhavsø med et internationalt miljø, gode strande, restauranter, et aktivt socialt liv og masser af muligheder for at opleve øen.

Virksomheden arrangerer blandt andet ugentlige Friday Drinks og forskellige sociale arrangementer, hvor du kan lære dine kollegaer og Malta bedre at kende.

HVAD FÅR DU?

✈️ Op til €1.000 i relocation-refusion til kandidater, der flytter til Malta

Refusionen kan blandt andet bruges til fly, taxi og dokumenterede udgifter i forbindelse med flytningen

God Løn

10% bonus udbetalt kvartalsvist

Mulighed for yderligere bonus efter 6 måneders ansættelse

️ 24 feriedage + 14 helligdage

Health & Life Insurance efter 6 måneders prøvetid

Gratis frugt, brød og morgenmadsprodukter på arbejdspladsen

Friday Drinks og andre sociale arrangementer

Gode muligheder for intern udvikling – både til andre afdelinger og management

Langsigtet kontrakt

HVEM ER DU?

Vi leder efter dig, der:

• Har gode engelskkundskaber både skriftligt og mundtligt

• Har erfaring fra kundeservice eller salg

• Er vant til at arbejde med KPI'er og data

• Er engageret, professionel og ansvarsbevidst

• Kan arbejde struktureret og følge procedurer

• Er god til at kommunikere med kunder og kollegaer

Det er en fordel, hvis du har erfaring fra kundeservice, salg eller den finansielle sektor, men det vigtigste er, at du er engageret, professionel og pålidelig.

PRAKTISK INFORMATION

Malta – Msida

Fuldtid

40 timer om ugen

Langsigtet kontrakt

1 dags oplæring

6 måneders prøvetid

Opfølgende reviews efter 1, 3 og 6 måneder

Hvis du gerne vil tage næste skridt i din karriere, samtidig med at du får mulighed for at bo og arbejde på Malta, er dette en spændende mulighed.

Der er en ledig stilling.

Ansøg allerede i dag.
Mathias@jobsqd.com

title: Kundenbetreuer (m/w/d) – Umzug nach Malta ( Umzugspaket inklusive ) (Berufsspezialist/in - Vertrieb)
description:
Als deutschsprachiger Kundenbetreuer (Customer Account Advisor) bist du Teil eines europäischen Kundenserviceteams und unterstützt internationale Kundinnen und Kunden direkt von unserem Büro im sonnigen Malta aus.

Du bist die zentrale Anlaufstelle für eine Vielzahl von Anfragen rund um Kundenkonten und sorgst für ein positives Serviceerlebnis.

Diese Position wird in Vollzeit angeboten und erfordert flexible Arbeitszeiten. Um dem vollen Sportkalender gerecht zu werden, arbeitest du im Schichtsystem an fünf von sieben Tagen – Wochenend- und Feiertagsarbeit ist regelmäßig vorgesehen.

Die Stelle ist Teil eines hybriden Arbeitsmodells – du arbeitest sowohl von zu Hause als auch im modernen Büro im Zentrum von Sliema, mit Meerblick und Zugang zu zahlreichen Freizeitmöglichkeiten.

Was wir bieten

- Vollständiges Umzugspaket (Details unten)
- Attraktives Jahresbruttogehalt von ca. 34.600 €
- Gehaltszuschläge abhängig von Arbeitszeiten
- Lebens- und Krankenversicherung
- Kostenlose Fitnessstudio-Mitgliedschaft
- Zusätzliche 5 % deines Bruttojahresgehalts als Altersvorsorge
- Hybrides Arbeitsmodell (Homeoffice + Büro)
- Umfassende Einarbeitung und kontinuierliches Coaching
- Interne Weiterentwicklungs- und Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten

Relocation-Paket

- 6 Wochen kostenlose Unterkunft bei Ankunft
- Rückerstattung des Flugtickets (bis zu 285 €)
- 800 € monatlicher Wohnzuschuss in den ersten 6 Monaten
- Zusätzlich 100 € monatlich in den ersten 6 Monaten für Heimflüge

Deine Aufgaben

- Kundenbetreuung via Live-Chat und E-Mail
- Bearbeitung von Anfragen zu Zahlungen, Verifizierung, technischen Themen und allgemeinen Kontofragen
- Eskalation komplexer Fälle an Fachabteilungen
- Zusammenarbeit mit internen Teams zur effizienten Problemlösung

Was du mitbringst

- Fließende Deutschkenntnisse
- Gute Englischkenntnisse (mindestens B2)
- Ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung
- Lösungsorientiertes Denken
- Bereitschaft zur Schichtarbeit, inklusive Wochenenden

Bereit für deinen Karrierestart unter der Sonne?

Dann bewirb dich jetzt mit deinem englischen Lebenslauf – wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

description:
PhD Candidate Towards a tiered risk assessment strategy to evaluate the safety of herbal supplements
30 augustus 2026 Maastricht University
WO
limburg, Maastricht
Geplaatst 9 uur geleden
Welcome to Maastricht University!
Would you like to help detect health risks in herbal food supplements earlier, using data-driven approaches? Herbal supplements are often considered safe because they are natural. But how well do we actually understand their potential health effects? In this PhD project, you will develop a testing strategy to identify possible hazards earlier and contribute to safer use of herbal supplements.
PhD Candidate: Towards a tiered risk assessment strategy to evaluate the safety of herbal supplements
Herbal food supplements are widely used and often perceived as inherently safe because they are 'natural'. Yet these products can contain complex mixtures of bioactive compounds, and their composition may vary depending on the plant material, extraction method and production process. Contamination, adulteration and differences between batches add further uncertainty. Because these products are generally not tested before entering the market, potential adverse effects may only become apparent once they are already widely used.
That is why a robust and structured strategy is needed to better evaluate the safety of herbal supplements and reduce potential risks to human health. In this collaborative project, you will investigate the hepatotoxicity, nephrotoxicity, genotoxicity and endocrine-disrupting potential of diverse herbal extracts using human-relevant in vitro models and complementary bioassays. You will also examine how liver metabolism influences their toxicity. For selected extracts, you will use chemical analyses such as LC-MS/MS and GC-MS to help identify the compounds responsible for the observed effects. title: PHD Candidate Towards a Tiered Risk Assessment Strategy
description:
PhD Candidate Towards a tiered risk assessment strategy to evaluate the safety of herbal supplements
Welcome to Maastricht University!
Would you like to help detect health risks in herbal food supplements earlier, using data-driven approaches? Herbal supplements are often considered safe because they are natural. But how well do we actually understand their potential health effects? In this PhD project, you will develop a testing strategy to identify possible hazards earlier and contribute to safer use of herbal supplements.
PhD Candidate: Towards a tiered risk assessment strategy to evaluate the safety of herbal supplements
Herbal food supplements are widely used and often perceived as inherently safe because they are 'natural'. Yet these products can contain complex mixtures of bioactive compounds, and their composition may vary depending on the plant material, extraction method and production process. Contamination, adulteration and differences between batches add further uncertainty. Because these products are generally not tested before entering the market, potential adverse effects may only become apparent once they are already widely used.
That is why a robust and structured strategy is needed to better evaluate the safety of herbal supplements and reduce potential risks to human health. In this collaborative project, you will investigate the hepatotoxicity, nephrotoxicity, genotoxicity and endocrine-disrupting potential of diverse herbal extracts using human-relevant in vitro models and complementary bioassays. You will also examine how liver metabolism influences their toxicity. For selected extracts, you will use chemical analyses such as LC-MS/MS and GC-MS to help identify the compounds responsible for the observed effects. The complementary PhD project at Utrecht University will investigate other potential adverse health effects, including neurotoxicity, cardiotoxicity and effects on the blood-brain barrier.

Flamingo Parket B.V. is committed to purchasing products and services that ensure materials come from legal sources and well-managed forests that are certified to compelling certification standards and/or come from post-consumer recycled materials.
As a cornerstone of this commitment, we pursue a Responsible Sourcing Program to promote the use and marketing of legal and environmentally responsible EUDR relevant products.
