Om arbeidsgiveren:

Vil du bli vår nye kollega? 

Arendal ble etablert som kjøbstad i mai 1723. Siden har det skjedd mye. I dag har Arendal kommune over 46 000 innbyggere. Kommunen er en handlekraftig organisasjon og en attraktiv arbeidsgiver for over 3500 medarbeidere. 

Vi løser viktige samfunnsoppgaver, og er en sentral aktør i utviklingen av byen og kommunen. Vi jobber aktivt med FNs bærekraftsmål, og vi er vertskommune for Arendalsuka - Norges største demokratifestival. 

Arbeidet skal preges av mangfold og våre medarbeidere skal gjenspeile Arendals befolkning. Vi ser mangfold som en styrke. Vi vil ha medarbeidere med ulike kompetanser, bakgrunn, erfaring og perspektiver for å bidra til enda bedre oppgaveløsning. 

Arendal kommune er sertifisert som likestilt arbeidsgiver. Vi oppfordrer alle som er kvalifisert; uansett alder, funksjonsevne, kjønn, seksuell orientering, religion og etnisk bakgrunn, til å søke jobb hos oss. Vi jobber for heltidskultur, og ansetter fortrinnsvis i hele stillinger. Se mer om vår arbeidsgiverstrategi.

I henhold til offentlighetslovens § 25. gjør vi oppmerksom på at opplysninger om søkeren kan bli gjort offentlig, selv om søkeren har bedt om unntak fra offentlighet.

For stillinger som arbeider med barn og unge, tjenester innen helse- og omsorg, eller brann- og eksplosjonsvern, må det foreligge tilfredsstillende politiattest før ansettelse.

title: Service Engineer- SeaQ Control
description:
VARD Electro is shaping the future of shipbuilding through advanced electrical, automation and integrated technology solutions. Through our SeaQ portfolio, we support our customers worldwide with reliable, intelligent systems that enhance safety, connectivity, and operational performance at sea.

Our Service Department is expanding, and we are looking for a Service Engineer in the SeaQ Control field to join us! SeaQ Control is VARD Electro's automation platform for monitoring and controlling vessel systems. The solution integrates alarm, monitoring and control functions and plays a key role in the safe and efficient operation of advanced vessels worldwide. You will join a specialized and collaborative environment where different disciplines come together to deliver cutting-edge solutions for the global maritime industry.

At VARD we care about nurturing talents and embracing diverse strengths, giving everyone the opportunity to develop and grow. Join us and be part of a community that celebrates your skills, and where together we are shaping the future of shipbuilding. 


Ready to make an impact at VARD?


Duties and responsibilities

As a Service Engineer, you will play a key role in the commissioning and service of our SeaQ Control systems delivered to customers worldwide. You will work hands-on with advanced automation and control systems, both on board vessels and in-house, contributing to projects that ensure safe and efficient vessel operations.
Your responsibilities will include troubleshooting and maintenance activities, and providing technical assistance to customers and colleagues. You will also participate in factory testing, reporting, and other in-house support activities.
This position involves extensive travel, and we are looking for someone who thrives in dynamic environments, enjoys solving technical challenges, works well independently, and has a strong customer-focused mindset.

Qualifications
  • Technical background/education within Automation (Technician Level/ Bachelor/ Master)
  • Experience from commissioning, service, troubleshooting or maintenance of automation and control systems
  • Strong competence in PLC, HMI, SCADA, industrial networks and instrumentation

 

VARD works systematically for inclusion and diversity and encourage everyone to apply, even if your competence does not match 100% the above. 

This employment may require a background check, or security clearance by the Norwegian National Security Authority.

Personal qualities
  • Strong technical understanding and interest 
  • Good troubleshooting and analytical skills
  • Customer-oriented mindset and professional communication skills
  • Good oral and written presentation skills in Norwegian and English
  • Ability to work both independently and in a team
  • Norwegian driver's license
  • Identify yourself with the VARD values Craftmanship, Salesmanship and Fellowship.
Our commitment to you 
  • A good working environment with exciting and important tasks in an international environment 
  • Competitive pension scheme and insurance package 
  • Subsidized lunch in the office canteen 
  • Subsidized membership at the gym 
  • Occupational health service 
  • Free mobile phone usage 
  • Central office location and free parking
  • Geographical / rotation flexibility
  • We understand the importance of continuous learning and we strive to give you the chance to gain new skills and further develop your career

 

VARD recognizes the importance of having fun at work, this is why with VARD Social you will have the chance to bond with colleagues through new experiences and shared interests. The social offer varies throughout the year and includes activities like 'walk and talk' during lunch hours, fjord cruises, cooking lessons, go karting, football practices and wine tasting, just to name a few. 

With the right blend of fun, expertise and hard work, we are creating ships for the future. Join us!

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Vard Electro is a globally recognized and trusted provider and advisor of marine electrical systems. Established in Norway in 1997, Vard Electro has today approx. 900 employees based in Norway, Romania, Brazil, Singapore, India, Italy, UK, Canada, USA and Vietnam, and operating worldwide.

In close cooperation with the customer, Vard Electro offers ­effective and environmentally friendly solutions with a focus on optimization of the operational performance. Vard Electro works with all established brands in the market, thereby giving customers smart solutions with a high degree of flexibility. Currently more than 300 vessels are sailing with integrated electrical systems, including complete systems for power ­management, propulsion, automation, and navigation, delivered by Vard Electro.

title: Medisinsk sekretær/ helsesekretær
description:
Ønsker du å jobbe i et aktivt miljø ved et av Norges mest moderne sykehus? Vi ser etter deg som er ansvarsbevisst, har gode samarbeidsevner og er opptatt av god pasientbehandling. 

Medisinsk merkantil består av 12 medarbeidere som arbeider med planlegging og koordinering av poliklinisk virksomhet ved Medisinsk klinikk på Haraldsplass diakonale sykehus. Våre fagfelt er mage- og tarmlidelser,  hjerte,  lunge, geriatri, infeksjon, nefrologi, hematologi og endokrinologi . Våre helsesekretærer har i tillegg ansvar for EKG/ blodtrykksmålinger i forkant av kardiologiske konsultasjoner. 

Vi har ledig 100% fast stilling som medisinsk sekretær/ helsesekretær. Arbeidet er på dagtid fra klokken 08.00 - 15.30. Oppstart er etter avtale.


Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Besvare telefonhenvendelser fra pasienter og pårørende
  • Timebestilling, innkalling og koordinering av undersøkelser for pasienter
  • Samarbeide med leger og sykepleiere for en optimal poliklinisk drift
  • Ta del i oppgaver som til enhver tid tilhører avdelingen
  • Tilleggsoppgaver kan bli aktuelle
Kvalifikasjoner
  • Hvis helsesekretær, norsk autorisasjon
  • Gode kommunikasjonsevner i norsk, både skriftlig og muntlig
  • Relevant sykehuserfaring er en fordel, men ikke et krav
  • Gode IKT kunnskaper. Erfaring fra DIPS Arena er en fordel, men ikke et krav
Personlige egenskaper
  • Du er ansvarsbevisst og serviceinnstilt
  • Du er punktlig, nøyaktig, pålitelig og strukturert
  • Du tilpasser deg lett, er løsningsorientert og har evne til å ta selvstendige avgjørelser
  • Du er endringsorientert og endringsvillig
  • Du har gode samarbeidsevner og evne til å se det store bildet
  • Du bidrar positivt til et godt arbeidsmiljø
Vi tilbyr
  • Lønn i samsvar med gjeldende overenskomst
  • En variert arbeidshverdag i et godt arbeidsmiljø.
  • God opplæring
  • Trivelig arbeidsmiljø der vi ser og oppmuntrer hverandre 
  • Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger gjennom KLP
  • Gode velferdsordninger som firmahytte, bedriftsidrettslag med treningsrom og mulighet for leie av bolig.

Mangfoldserklæring

Haraldsplass Diakonale Sykehus ønsker å gjenspeile mangfoldet i befolkningen i vår rekruttering. Vi oppfordrer alle som er kvalifiserte til å søke ledige stillinger uansett kjønn, alder, funksjonsevne og flerkulturell bakgrunn. Det samme gjelder dersom man har hatt et lengre opphold fra arbeidslivet. Haraldsplass Diakonale Sykehus ønsker å legge til rette for et inkluderende rekruttering.

5009 BERGEN

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Haraldsplass diakonale sykehus AS er en del av spesialisthelsetjenesten, og et av tre store private ideelle sykehus i Norge. Vi har lokalsykehusansvar i indremedisin for bydelene Åsane, Arna, Bergenhus, Gulen, Samnanger og kommunene i Nordhordland.

Haraldsplass tilbyr akutte og planlagte spesialisthelsetjenester innen indremedisin, kirurgi og ortopedi, samt laboratorie- og radiologiske tjenester, med tilhørende poliklinisk aktivitet. Medisinsk klinikk tilbyr tjenester innen geriatri, akutt- og mottaksmedisin, endokrinologi, gastroenterologi, hematologi, infeksjonsmedisin, kardiologi, lungemedisin og nefrologi. Kirurgisk klinikk tilbyr tjenester innen gastroenterologisk kirurgi, urologi, generellkirurgi, plastikkirurgi, innen ortopedi tilbys skulder-, kne-, fot-, hånd- og albuekirurgi.

Vi er utdanningsplattform for studenter fra UiB og VID, for LIS1, LIS2 og LIS3, og for helsefagarbeidere. Haraldsplass har høy andel leger med doktorgrad og flertallet av disse er førsteamanuensis ved UiB og ansvarlig for medisinstudiet der.  
Våre kjerneverdier er kompetent, respektfull, medmenneskelig og samhandlende. Disse skal ligge til grunn for vår videre utvikling. Vi skal være innovative, modige, stå i spissen for bruk av ny teknologi, og bidra med gode eksempler til en positiv endring av helsetjenesten.

Les mer om oss på vår hjemmeside www.haraldsplass.no
Besøk også vår YouTube-kanal for å få et innblikk i livet på Haraldsplass.

Haraldsplass diakonale sykehus er en del av Stiftelsen Diakonova Haraldsplass som har virksomheter innenfor sykehus, barnevern, høgskole, eldreomsorg og psykiatri. Mottoet «Kompetanse med hjertevarme» forplikter til å vise nestekjærlighet og respekt for den enkeltes personlighet og integritet gjennom engasjement, inkluderende fellesskap, fokus på miljø og kamp for rettferdighet. Stiftelseskonsernet vil fortsette å utvikle sin relevans for samfunnet gjennom å tilknytte seg høyt kvalifiserte, engasjerte og profesjonelle medarbeidere.

title: Virksomhetsleder Miljø og samferdsel
description:
Vil du lede en virksomhet med ansvar for samferdsel, kommunal infrastruktur og offentlige rom?

Ålesund kommune søker en tydelig og utviklingsorientert virksomhetsleder for Miljø og samferdsel. Vi ser etter deg som vil lede en kompleks og viktig virksomhet med ansvar for forvaltning, myndighetsutøvelse, drift og utvikling innen samferdsel, kommunal infrastruktur og offentlige rom.

Virksomheten har ansvar for forvaltning, myndighetsutøvelse, planarbeid, drift, vedlikehold og utvikling innen samferdsel og kommunal infrastruktur. Ansvarsområdet omfatter blant annet kommunale veger, gang- og sykkelveger, parkeringsplasser, broer, kaier, trapper, parker, grøntområder, friområder, byrom, lekeplasser, offentlige toaletter og enkelte idrettsanlegg. Vinter- og sommerdrift er en sentral del av oppgavene. Virksomheten planlegger og gjennomfører også utviklingsprosjekter på kommunal veg og i offentlige rom, og følger opp kommunens ansvar i Bypakke Ålesund.

Som virksomhetsleder får du et helhetlig ansvar for fag, økonomi, personell og utvikling. Du skal videreutvikle en organisasjon med bredt ansvarsområde, sikre god drift og kvalitet, og bidra til samhandling på tvers av fagmiljø og samarbeidspartnere.

Virksomheten har tre avdelinger i dag:

  • Forvaltning
  • Drift
  • Prosjekt

Stillingen inngår i kommunalområde Samfunn, og du blir en del av ledergruppen. Sammen har ledergruppen ansvar for å videreutvikle og profesjonalisere kommunens tjenester.

Kommunens omdømme skapes av dyktige medarbeidere som hver dag bidrar med kompetanse, engasjement og samfunnsansvar på ulike arenaer.

 


Arbeidsoppgaver

Du vil blant annet få ansvar for:

  • å lede og videreutvikle virksomheten i samsvar med kommunens mål og prioriteringer.
  • å sikre forsvarlig drift, forvaltning og myndighetsutøvelse innen virksomhetens ansvarsområder.
  • økonomi, budsjett, rapportering og ressursbruk innenfor vedtatte rammer.
  • å bidra til god gjennomføring av store investerings- og utviklingsprosjekter.
  • å følge opp kommunens ansvar i Bypakke Ålesund og andre samarbeidsprosjekter.
  • å legge til rette for medvirkning, kompetanseutvikling og et godt arbeidsmiljø.
Kvalifikasjoner

Vi ønsker at du har:

  • høyere utdanning på bachelor- eller masternivå innen tekniske tjenester, samferdsel, ingeniørfag eller andre relevante fagområder.
  • ledererfaring med ansvar for økonomi, personell og fag.
  • erfaring fra kommunal sektor.
  • erfaring med organisasjonsutvikling, endringsarbeid eller komplekse drifts- og forvaltningsmiljø.
  • god forståelse for økonomistyring og offentlig forvaltning.

Det er en fordel med erfaring fra samferdsel, kommunalteknikk, drift av infrastruktur, prosjektgjennomføring eller andre relevante tekniske tjenester.

Personlige egenskaper

Vi søker deg som:

  • er en tydelig og samlende leder.
  • har god gjennomføringsevne og evne til å prioritere.
  • kombinerer strategisk blikk med operativ forståelse.
  • bygger tillit og skaper gode samarbeidsrelasjoner i organisasjonen, med politikere og med innbyggere og næringsliv.
  • er utviklingsorientert og motiveres av et viktig samfunnsoppdrag.
  • har gode samarbeidsevner, tydelig kommunikasjon og endringskompetanse.
Vi tilbyr
  • en sentral lederstilling med stor samfunnsmessig betydning.
  • ansvar for en virksomhet med høy faglig kompetanse og viktige utviklingsoppgaver.
  • mulighet til å påvirke utviklingen av kommunens samferdselsløsninger, infrastruktur og offentlige rom.
  • samarbeid med sterke fagmiljø og støttefunksjoner innen innkjøp, HR, kommunikasjon, juridiske tjenester og økonomi.
  • lønn etter avtale.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Ålesund kommune er den største kommunen mellom Bergen og Trondheim, og et regionsenter for Nordvestlandet. Kommunen har rundt 58.000 innbyggere. Området rundt byr på rike muligheter for et aktivt friluftsliv for alle, jakt og fiske, og kommunen har et rikt og blomstrende kultur- og næringsliv. Ålesund er en universitetsby og har landets største universitet, NTNU.

Kommunen er en stor arbeidsgiver med sine over 4.500 dyktige og engasjerte medarbeidere som utfører viktige samfunnsoppdrag. I det daglige arbeidet vektlegger vi verdiene våre: åpen, engasjert og modig. Visjonen for kommunen er «nasjonal slagkraft, regional attraktivitet og lokal identitet».

description:
🍀 Sous Chef Wanted – O’Connor’s Irish Pub, Stavanger

Full-time | Start ASAP | 1–2 month trial through Staffers | Permanent opportunity

Are you an experienced chef ready to take more responsibility in the kitchen?

O’Connor’s Irish Pub Stavanger is looking for an experienced and reliable Sous Chef to join their team as soon as possible.

The position will initially be a 1–2 month full-time assignment through Staffers, giving both you and the restaurant the opportunity to make sure it’s a great match. If everything works well, the plan is for you to move into a permanent position directly with O’Connor’s after the trial period.

Located in the heart of Stavanger, O’Connor’s combines the atmosphere of a traditional Irish pub with a busy social environment and a kitchen serving classic, hearty pub food.

👨‍🍳 The role

As Sous Chef, you’ll play an important role in the daily operation of the kitchen.

You’ll work closely with the rest of the kitchen team, take responsibility during service and help make sure the kitchen runs smoothly, efficiently and consistently.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Taking responsibility for the kitchen and service when required
  • Preparing and cooking dishes according to the restaurant’s menu and standards
  • Managing your own section during busy services
  • Supporting and guiding other members of the kitchen team
  • Organising mise en place and preparation
  • Helping maintain good structure and workflow in the kitchen
  • Ensuring high standards of quality, cleanliness and food safety
  • Keeping calm and organised during busy periods
  • Cooperating closely with both the kitchen and front-of-house teams
  • Supporting the Head Chef and contributing to the overall operation of the kitchen

🔎 We’re looking for someone who:

  • Has solid professional experience as a chef
  • Ideally has previous experience as a Sous Chef, Senior Chef or Chef de Partie with additional responsibility
  • Is confident taking responsibility during service
  • Can work independently and make decisions when needed
  • Is organised, reliable and takes ownership of their work
  • Works efficiently without compromising quality
  • Is comfortable working in a busy, high-volume kitchen
  • Has a positive attitude and works well with others
  • Can communicate comfortably in English or Norwegian
  • Is available to start as soon as possible
  • Is interested in a long-term opportunity if the role is a good match

Experience from pub food, casual dining, à la carte or high-volume kitchens is a strong advantage.

⭐ What’s on offer?

  • Start as soon as possible
  • An initial 1–2 month trial period through Staffers
  • Clear opportunity to be hired directly by O’Connor’s after the trial period
  • A senior role with responsibility in the kitchen
  • A lively workplace in central Stavanger
  • A well-established restaurant and hospitality group
  • The opportunity to show what you can do before both sides commit long-term

📍 Location

  • O’Connor’s Irish Pub – Stavanger
  • Klubbgata 1, Stavanger

Interested?

If you’re an experienced chef who is ready to take the next step, take responsibility in the kitchen and potentially become a permanent part of the team, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply now – interviews are being held continuously and the ideal candidate can start immediately.

O'Conners Stavanger is a vibrant bar located in the heart of Stavanger, offering a welcoming and lively atmosphere for both locals and visitors alike. Our establishment prides itself on providing a unique experience where guests can enjoy a wide selection of beverages, live music, and a cozy setting for social gatherings. With a focus on exceptional service and creating memorable moments for our patrons, O'Conners Stavanger is committed to upholding the tradition of Irish hospitality with a modern twist. title: Service Engineer- SeaQ Control
description:
VARD Electro is shaping the future of shipbuilding through advanced electrical, automation and integrated technology solutions. Through our SeaQ portfolio, we support our customers worldwide with reliable, intelligent systems that enhance safety, connectivity, and operational performance at sea.

Our Service Department is expanding, and we are looking for a Service Engineer in the SeaQ Control field to join us! SeaQ Control is VARD Electro's automation platform for monitoring and controlling vessel systems. The solution integrates alarm, monitoring and control functions and plays a key role in the safe and efficient operation of advanced vessels worldwide. You will join a specialized and collaborative environment where different disciplines come together to deliver cutting-edge solutions for the global maritime industry.

At VARD we care about nurturing talents and embracing diverse strengths, giving everyone the opportunity to develop and grow. Join us and be part of a community that celebrates your skills, and where together we are shaping the future of shipbuilding. 


Ready to make an impact at VARD?


Duties and responsibilities

As a Service Engineer, you will play a key role in the commissioning and service of our SeaQ Control systems delivered to customers worldwide. You will work hands-on with advanced automation and control systems, both on board vessels and in-house, contributing to projects that ensure safe and efficient vessel operations.
Your responsibilities will include troubleshooting and maintenance activities, and providing technical assistance to customers and colleagues. You will also participate in factory testing, reporting, and other in-house support activities.
This position involves extensive travel, and we are looking for someone who thrives in dynamic environments, enjoys solving technical challenges, works well independently, and has a strong customer-focused mindset.

Qualifications
  • Technical background/education within Automation (Technician Level/ Bachelor/ Master)
  • Experience from commissioning, service, troubleshooting or maintenance of automation and control systems
  • Strong competence in PLC, HMI, SCADA, industrial networks and instrumentation

 

VARD works systematically for inclusion and diversity and encourage everyone to apply, even if your competence does not match 100% the above. 

This employment may require a background check, or security clearance by the Norwegian National Security Authority.

Personal qualities
  • Strong technical understanding and interest 
  • Good troubleshooting and analytical skills
  • Customer-oriented mindset and professional communication skills
  • Good oral and written presentation skills in Norwegian and English
  • Ability to work both independently and in a team
  • Norwegian driver's license
  • Identify yourself with the VARD values Craftmanship, Salesmanship and Fellowship.
Our commitment to you 
  • A good working environment with exciting and important tasks in an international environment 
  • Competitive pension scheme and insurance package 
  • Subsidized lunch in the office canteen 
  • Subsidized membership at the gym 
  • Occupational health service 
  • Free mobile phone usage 
  • Central office location and free parking
  • Geographical / rotation flexibility
  • We understand the importance of continuous learning and we strive to give you the chance to gain new skills and further develop your career

 

VARD recognizes the importance of having fun at work, this is why with VARD Social you will have the chance to bond with colleagues through new experiences and shared interests. The social offer varies throughout the year and includes activities like 'walk and talk' during lunch hours, fjord cruises, cooking lessons, go karting, football practices and wine tasting, just to name a few. 

With the right blend of fun, expertise and hard work, we are creating ships for the future. Join us!

title: Vil du være med å skape trygghet på veiene?
description:
Ramudden søker nå flere trafikkmedarbeidere til vår avdeling i Drammen. 

Trives du i en aktiv hverdag med mye utfordringer og variasjon i arbeidet? Setter du sikkerhet og folka først? Vi ser etter trafikkmedarbeidere som kan hjelpe oss å vokse videre og møte etterspørselen fra våre kunder i tiden fremover.

Vi bistår våre kunder med alt innenfor trafikksikkerhet, og du vil få mulighet til å være tett på både små og store vei-, vedlikeholds- og byggeprosjekter i hele Buskerud.

 

Arbeidsoppgaver 

  • Dirigere trafikk og bidra til trygg ferdsel ved vei- og anleggsarbeid
  • Ledebilkjøring
  • Montering av midlertidig sikring
  • Transportoppdrag
  • Forvarslingsvogn
  • Skilting

Vi har også monteringsoppdrag tilknyttet bygg, anlegg, tunneldrift og ulike vakt- og beredskapsoppdrag. Vi er ofte involvert i større publikumsarrangementer i området, så her er det stor variasjon og ingen dag er lik! 

 

Hvem vi søker

Vi er en sammensatt gjeng med ulik bakgrunn, erfaring og utdanning. Har du erfaring fra bransjen, er det en fordel, men ikke et krav. Det viktigste for oss er at du tar sikkerhet på alvor og forholder deg til gjeldende regler og rutiner som bidrar til at alle kommer trygt hjem hver dag. En jobb hos oss innebærer et viktig ansvar for sikkerheten til både kolleger, trafikanter og andre som ferdes på og langs norske veier. 

Kvalifikasjoner: 

  • Førerkort klasse B
  • Førerkort klasse BE og C er en fordel, men ikke et krav
  • Bestå AVK 1 og 3 (ikke et krav før ansettelse, men du må bestå dette for å kunne jobbe ute på veien)
  • Av sikkerhetsårsaker og dokumentasjonskrav må du kunne kommunisere godt på norsk, muntlig og skriftlig
  • Benytte telefon og ulike digitale systemer i din arbeidshverdag

Personlige egenskaper: 

  • Har godt humør og bidrar positivt i møte med både kunder og kolleger
  • Jobber strukturert og nøyaktig, med høyt fokus på sikkerhet og dokumentasjon.
  • Er fleksibel når det gjelder arbeidstid og kan jobbe både dag, kveld og natt
  • Er praktisk og teknisk anlagt
  • Trives med en fysisk arbeidshverdag som innebærer å stå/gå/løfte utstyr

 

Vi kan tilby 

  • Konkurransedyktig lønn etter tariff
  • Et godt arbeidsmiljø og gode kollegaer som har det morsomt sammen på jobb
  • Gode utviklingsmuligheter internt i Ramudden, lokalt og nasjonalt
  • En fleksibel arbeidshverdag som passer godt for deg som trives med varierte arbeidstider
  • 30-60 % stilling

 

Høres dette ut som noe for deg? Vi gleder oss til å få flere nye kolleger med på laget, og håper du er en av dem!

Ta gjerne kontakt om du skulle ha noen spørsmål.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Ramudden Norge er en del av Ramudden Global med over 5 000 medarbeidere og 1 milliard euro i omsetning. Selskapet har hovedkontor i Gävle i Sverige, og består av over 70 avdelinger i 13 land fordelt på 2 kontinenter. Konsernets misjon er å bringe folk hjem trygt hver dag (To get people home safely every day). Ramudden i Norge har vokst siden starten i 2009 og spesielt etter 2015. I dag består selskapet av 13 forskjellige avdelinger fra Steinkjer i nord til Lindesnes i sør. Vi er drøyt 500 medarbeidere og omsetningen nærmer seg 500 millioner kroner, med store ambisjoner om å vokse enda mer. Ramudden leverer sikkerhetstjenester i og rundt veinettet og på byggeplasser i Norge, blant annet rådgivning, utleie av sikkerhetsutstyr, opplæring av personell, og tjenesteleveranser som f.eks. montering av utstyr og trafikkdirigering.

title: Montør av Plasthaller. Installation Worker for Fabric Halls and Steel Construction
description:
We are a company working with the assembly, disassembly and maintenance of fabric halls (PVC halls) and warehouse halls of all sizes and for various purposes throughout Norway, and occasionally abroad. We are now looking for additional employees to join our installation team.

Hva vi ser etter

We are looking for motivated and hardworking people who are not afraid to take responsibility and get the job done.

You enjoy physical work and working at height, and you are comfortable using lifts and working on construction sites.

You like travelling and working at different locations around Norway.

You can work independently, while also working well as part of a team.

You are reliable, engaged and take pride in your work.

You enjoy challenges and want to learn and develop in a professional working environment.

Experience with steel construction assembly and/or installation of fabric halls (PVC halls) is a strong advantage.

You must be able to understand and communicate safety instructions in English .

Norwegian language skills are a strong advantage.

A valid driving licence (class B) is required.

Lift and forklift certificates are an advantage, but not required -- training can be provided.

Arbeidsoppgaver

Assembly and disassembly of fabric halls (PVC halls) in various sizes and types.

This includes installation of steel structures and PVC fabric as cladding.

A lot of the work is performed at height using lifts, so fear of heights is not suitable for this job.

Steel structures are assembled on the ground, lifted into position using a crane, and completed before the fabric is installed.

The work also includes a significant amount of manual tasks such as measuring and anchoring base plates, assembling small and large steel components, and tensioning the fabric.

Extensive travel is required, as we carry out assignments ranging from one-day repair jobs to large projects lasting several weeks, all across Norway.

Vi tilbyr

We offer full training and exciting challenges in a growing company.

All necessary courses and certifications are provided, so you will be properly trained for the job.

We offer competitive salary and good working conditions.

You will have an independent and varied job with freedom under responsibility and the opportunity to develop your skills.

The position involves extensive travel, allowing you to experience many different locations, work at varied sites, and meet new people all the time.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

We are a well-established and growing company specialising in all aspects of fabric halls, including assembly, disassembly, relocation and maintenance of fabric halls and warehouse halls of all sizes and applications.

With our office and warehouse in Krøderen, we deliver projects across Norway and occasionally abroad, offering varied workdays and exciting challenges.

We work with both small and large clients within industries such as industry, agriculture, transport and logistics.

Today, our team consists of 18 skilled installation workers and 10 fully equipped service vehicles, providing the right tools and support to deliver high-quality work.

Founded in 2005, we have nearly 20 years of experience and are a stable employer with strong expertise in our field.

Our vision is to build high-quality solutions and create a great workplace for everyone, while striving to be the best in our industry through quality, safety and teamwork.

title: PhD Position in Long-term Climate Governance
description:
PhD Position in Long-term Climate Governance

Oslo Business School at Oslo Metropolitan University (OsloMet) invites applications for a temporary position as PhD scholar in long-term climate governance. The position is connected to the ERC-funded research project CAMELOT – Capacities for More Effective Long-term Climate Governance and is expected to start in April 2027.

The position is three years full-time but can be extended to four years if teaching assignments are included. The PhD Research Fellow will be based in the academic unit Public Administration and Governance at Oslo Business School and will be enrolled in OsloMet's PhD programme in Social Sciences, specialization Business Administration, Innovation and Governance (BIG).

The successful candidate is expected to complete the doctoral degree during the period of employment.


About CAMELOT

Many of today's most consequential governance challenges, including climate change and Earth system risks, unfold over decades, centuries, or longer. Yet political institutions and decision-making processes often struggle to engage effectively with such long-term futures.

CAMELOT investigates the capacities that enable individuals, groups, and institutions to think about and govern for the long term. The project develops new theory on long-term governance capacities and studies whether and how such capacities can be strengthened through experimental and participatory research. It brings together insights from political science, public administration, environmental governance, sustainability science, futures studies, psychology, and related fields.

CAMELOT is a five-year research project funded by a European Research Council (ERC) Consolidator Grant and led by Associate professor Manjana Milkoreit at OsloMet.

CAMELOT project website


About the PhD project

The PhD scholar will develop an independent research project that contributes to CAMELOT's overarching objective of understanding and strengthening capacities for long-term climate governance.

The project should be theoretically informed and empirically grounded and involve original empirical research designed and conducted by the PhD candidate. The research may build on, extend, or enable comparisons with research undertaken elsewhere in CAMELOT, but should not depend on data collection undertaken in other parts of the project.

We welcome innovative proposals addressing questions related to long-term governance capacities. Possible research directions include, but are not limited to:

  • investigating how narratives and stories about long-term climate futures influence imagination, understanding, attitudes, decision-making, or other capacities relevant to long-term governance
  • examining how engagement with long-term climate futures differs across climate risks, Earth system tipping elements, audiences, social groups, professional communities, or political and cultural contexts
  • studying how scenarios, foresight, simulations, serious games, or other futures-oriented interventions affect capacities for anticipatory and long-term governance
  • developing and evaluating educational or professional interventions designed to strengthen capacities for engaging with long-term climate futures
  • investigating whether and under what conditions changes in long-term governance capacities translate into changes in reasoning, decision-making, or action

Applicants are encouraged to propose original research questions and approaches that extend beyond these examples while demonstrating a clear connection to CAMELOT's overarching research agenda.

A range of methodological approaches may be appropriate, including quantitative, qualitative, experimental, and mixed-methods research. The proposed research must be feasible within the period of employment.

The candidate will conduct their own research while working closely with the CAMELOT team. They will benefit from interaction with CAMELOT's theoretical, experimental, and participatory research and may develop complementary or comparative studies building on concepts, methods, interventions, or findings developed within the project.


Qualification requirements

We are looking for candidates who meet the following requirements:

  • master's degree of 120 ECTS or equivalent in political science, public administration, environmental governance, sustainability science, sociology, psychology, futures studies, science and technology studies, human geography, or another field relevant to the position
  • grade of B or better on both the master's thesis and the master's degree overall, or an equivalent academic record
  • demonstrate knowledge of research methods relevant to the proposed PhD project
  • strong analytical and academic writing skills
  • excellent written and spoken English

Candidates who are close to completing their master's degree may apply, provided that the degree is completed before the start of the position.

It will be an advantage

It will be considered an advantage to have knowledge of or previous research experience related to one or more of the following areas: climate or environmental governance; public policy; long-term or anticipatory governance; futures and foresight; environmental or political psychology; narratives and communication; Earth system risks and tipping points; or experimental and intervention-based social science.

Experience with empirical data collection and analysis, participation in research projects, academic publishing, or interdisciplinary research will also be considered an advantage.

General criteria for employment as a Research Fellow are stipulated in the Regulations relating to the Universities and University Colleges Act. 

Admission to the doctoral program is a prerequisite. Admission to the doctoral program is based on a comprehensive assessment of the application, including the relevance and quality of the project description. A finalized project plan for the employment period is required completed and acknowledged within 3 months from the date of employment.

See information about admission criteria to the PhD-programme.

It is important for OsloMet to reflect the diverse and multicultural populationof our region, and all qualified candidates are welcome to apply. We make active endeavors to further develop OsloMet as an inclusive workplace and to adapt the workplace if required. If there are periods where you have not been in work or have been studying or in training, you are also welcome to apply.


We offer

The successful candidate will join an interdisciplinary and international research environment working at the intersection of climate governance, public policy, futures research, and the social sciences.

The position offers:

  • exciting job tasks at Norway’s third largest university
  • opportunities for academic development in a professional research environment
  • three-year full-time position with 100% salary; possibility to extend to 4 years with teaching duties
  • beneficial pension arrangements with the Norwegian State Pension Fund 
  • good employee welfare arrangements
  • free Norwegian classes to employees
  • working location in downtown Oslo with multiple cultural offers
  • close integration into the ERC-funded CAMELOT research team and the Public Administration and Governance research environment at Oslo Business School
  • close supervision and intellectual exchange with researchers working on long-term governance, climate governance, experimental social science, futures and anticipation, and science-policy engagement

The position provides an opportunity to develop an independent scholarly profile while being embedded in a larger international research project with strong connections to academic and policy communities.

The salary for the position is in accordance with the Basic Collective Agreement for state employees and OsloMets pay policy for PhD Candidate in code 1017), corresponding to 550 800 NOK per year. From the salary, 2% will be deducted in pension contributions for the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK). (double check salary in the salary plan booklet and pay scales set by OsloMet).

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SHi5avzdHIkApplication Process 

If you wish to apply for the position, you must do so through our recruitment system.

Please upload the following documents together by the application deadline: 

  • an application letter (maximum two pages) explaining your motivation for applying and how your background, research interests, and experience are relevant to the position 
  • a project proposal (maximum five pages, excluding references), following the requirements above
  • CV
  • certificates and transcripts for bachelor's and master's degrees, including grades; The certificates/diplomas must include ECTS grades (A–F). Foreign diplomas must be translated into English by the degree-conferring institution.
  • a copy of the master's thesis and up to two published academic works
  • names and contact information for two reference persons. Reference letters are not required at the application stage.

We only consider applications submitted through our electronic recruitment system, and all documents must be uploaded for your application to be considered. The documents must be in a Scandinavian language or English. Translations must be authorized, and you will be asked to present originals if you are invited for an interview. OsloMet verifies documents to give candidates a proper evaluation and ensure fair competition. Incomplete applications will not be considered.

For relevant positions, OsloMet conducts background checks of applicants in cooperation with an external provider, in order to verify information contained in available documents. Background checks are always carried out with the candidate’s consent, and employment in these positions is conditional upon an approved background check. Relevant applicants will receive further information about this.


Other information 

If you would like more information about the position, feel free to contact:

  • Head of unit Siri Brorstad Borlaug, (+47) 993 05 003 
  • Associate professor Manjana Milkoreit, (+47) 922 81 887 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

 

OsloMet – Oslo Metropolitan Universityis Norway's third-largest university, with 23,000 students and more than 2,600 employees. We have campuses in central Oslo and the Romerike region. Our research and education address the needs of working life, the welfare state, and the wider metropolitan region.

 

For more than 200 years,OsloMet – Oslo Metropolitan Universityhas contributed to building the knowledge and expertise that underpin the Norwegian welfare state. Today, OsloMet is a modern, urban university with strong academic environments in teacher education, health and social sciences, social research, design, and technology.

title: Researcher in Applied Mineralogy
description:
About the position and project

The Natural History Museum (NHM) at the University of Oslo invites applications for a two-year, full-time position as a Researcher in applied mineralogy and industrial mineral exploration. The position will be based in the Department of Research and Collections, within the Norwegian Centre for Mineralogy Research Group. The position is part of the innovation industry-research project “PureQ – The Future of the High-Purity Quartz Value Chain for Improved Yield, Quality and Sustainability”, funded by the Research Council of Norway.

The successful and highly motivated candidate will have a strong publication record and demonstrated experience with modern, advanced microanalytical techniques for mineral characterisation, particularly of quartz. Relevant expertise includes crystal chemistry and microtextural characterisation. Experience in mineral exploration, especially geochemical exploration and drill-core logging, is also desirable.


Qualifications requirements 

Required qualifications:
•    A PhD in geology or mineralogy
•    Demonstrated ability to conduct elemental microanalysis using LA-ICP-MS, including data processing and interpretation
•    A recent publication record relevant to the subject area of the position
•    A strong upward academic trajectory

The successful candidate must demonstrate mastery of English as working language. Proficiency in Norwegian is an advantage.

Desirable qualifications:
•    Familiarity with a range of microanalytical and spectrometric techniques used for mineral analysis besides LA-ICP-MS, such as SEM, EPMA, and CL


Personal qualities
  • High motivation to work at the interface between academia and industry
  • Ability to meet project reporting deadlines consistently 
  • Willingness to travel frequently within Norway and abroad as part of the project
  • Ability to create and contribute to a well-functioning, inclusive, and productive research environment
  • Ability to cooperate and communicate well with other staff members
  • Strong networking skills and the ability to collaborate and communicate effectively

The successful candidate should have an international profile with respect to the above criteria. The candidate for this position will be selected based on excellence and fit with the section’s research profile.


We need different perspectives in our work 

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues—could you be the next one?

We will provide appropriate accommodations should you need them. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps, we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports.

More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here.

We hope you will apply for the position with us. 


We offer
  • A professionally stimulating work environment
  • Building networks within the national geoscience and mineral industry sectors
  • Onboarding program for new employees
  • Good welfare schemes, in addition to Oslo´s family-friendly environment with its rich opportunities for culture and outdoor activities 
  • Salary in position as Researcher (position code 1109) in salary range NOK from 620 000 to 720 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund.

Application

Your application should include:

  • Application letter
  • CV
  • A complete list of publications
  • Transcripts and certificates
  • Names and contact details of 2-3 references (name, relation to candidate, e-mail and telephone number)

Your CV must be entered in Jobbnorge’s CV form and cannot be submitted only as an attachment. This requirement is intended to ensure correct documentation and record-keeping in accordance with the Public Administration Act, Section 15.

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for this job".

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.


General information

Please note that we are unable to add documentation after the application deadline. As the deadline applies equally to all applicants, this policy ensures equal treatment throughout the recruitment process. If you experience difficulties uploading documents in Jobbnorge, please contact their customer service: Phone: +47 75 54 22 20 or Email: support@grade.com 

The primary method of communication throughout the process will be e-mails and messages through the recruitment system Jobbnorge. When you receive a notification of a message in Jobbnorge, please log in to read it, as it may be important.

The best qualified candidates will invited for interviews.

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we cannot, you will hear from us.

Please refer to  Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian) and Rules for the use of research posts SKO 1108, 1109, 1110 and 1183 at UiO.

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees to secure the rights to all research results and related intellectual property.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest ranked educational and research institution, with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. With its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally recognised research communities, UiO is an important contributor to society.

The Natural History Museum at the University of Oslo is Norway’s most comprehensive natural history collection. For almost 200 years, specimens of animals, fungi, plants, rocks, minerals and fossils have been collected, studied and preserved here. The museum is located at Økern and in the beautiful Botanical Garden, which is not only popular for recreation, but is a scientific collection in itself.

title: Cyber Security Manager
description:

We are currently looking for a Cyber Security Manager to join our team. In this role, you will have the opportunity to apply your expertise, collaborate with skilled colleagues, and contribute to exciting projects across the VARD value chain.

Ready to make an impact at VARD?


Duties and responsibilities

The Cyber Security Manager will be responsible for cyber security governance, compliance, and product security across Vard Electro's portfolio. Qualifications

With the right blend of fun, expertise and hard work, we are creating ships for the future. Join us!

title: PhD Research Fellow in fairness in artificial intelligence
description:
About the position

We invite applications for a PhD Research Fellow position in fairness in artificial intelligence, available at the Department of Informatics, in the Scientific Computing and Machine Learning (SCML) research group.

Starting date as soon as possible/by agreement. The fellowship period is three (3) years.

Depending on the candidate and the teaching needs of the department, the fellowship period can be extended either for compulsory work consisting of e.g., teaching and supervision duties and research assistance up top four years.

No one can be appointed for more than one PhD Research Fellowship period at the University of Oslo.

Place of work is the Department of Informatics at Blindern, Oslo. 


Project description

The PhD fellow will be affiliated with the Scientific Computing and Machine Learning (SCML) research group at the Department of Informatics and supervised by associate professor Anne-Marie George.

We are looking for a motivated and academically strong candidate to work on a project within fairness in artificial intelligence and machine learning. The candidate will investigate how to formally define, measure and reconcile different, at times conflicting, notions of fairness in AI systems, as well as the theoretical relationships between them.

Possible directions for the project include (the final scope will be developed together with the candidate, and it is not necessary to cover all topics):

  • Group fairness: developing and analysing algorithms and metrics for ensuring fair treatment of groups defined by protected attributes (e.g. gender, age, ethnicity, …).
  • Theoretical relations between fairness notions: studying the mathematical relationships, trade-offs, and impossibility results connecting different fairness definitions.
  • Intersectional fairness: exploring fairness guarantees for combinations of multiple protected attributes, and addressing the challenges of subgroup fairness, such as computational complexity, statistical reliability and data sparsity for fine-grained subgroups.

What skills are important in this role?

The Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences has a strategic ambition to be among Europe’s leading communities for research, education and innovation. Candidates for these fellowships will be selected in accordance with this, and expected to be in the upper segment of their class with respect to academic credentials.

Required qualifications:

  • Master’s degree or equivalent in informatics/computer science, mathematics, statistics, or a closely related field. Foreign completed degree (M.Sc.-level) corresponding to a minimum of four years in the Norwegian educational system
  • Documented competence in machine learning at Master level
  • Documented programming skills
  • Minimum three documented mathematics or statistics courses with passing grade B or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English

Candidates without a master’s degree have until 30.11.2026 to complete the final exam.

Desired qualifications:

  • Programming experience, e.g. in Python, particularly for machine learning
  • Experience with machine learning theory, evaluation metrics, algorithmic fairness, statistics, or optimization is an advantage

Language requirement:

  • Good oral and written communication skills in English
  • English requirements for applicants from outside of EU/ EEA countries and exemptions from the requirements:
    https://www.mn.uio.no/english/research/phd/regulations/regulations.html#toc8

Grade requirements:
The norm is as follows:

  • The average grade point for courses included in the Bachelor’s degree must be C or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • The average grade point for courses included in the Master’s degree must be B or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • The Master’s thesis must have the grade B or better in the Norwegian educational system

The purpose of the fellowship is research training leading to the successful completion of a PhD degree. For more information see:
http://www.mn.uio.no/english/research/phd/

UiO is subject to the Security Act, which governs the organisation's protection of security-sensitive objects and knowledge, in addition to other relevant legislation concerning access to and handling of sensitive information. Based on this, it is a requirement that successful applicants are security-eligible. We may use background checks as part of our recruitment process.


What are we looking for in you?

Personal skills:

  • Ability to work both independently and as part of a team
  • Good communication and collaboration skills
  • Strong analytical skills and critical thinking
  • Enthusiasm, creativity, self-motivation, perseverance and initiative
  • Ability to take responsibility for your work — including troubleshooting, acquiring additional skills and asking for help when needed

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal skills.


We can offer you
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development
  • Committed colleagues in a good working environment
  • Good welfare schemes
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities
  • Career development programmes
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes
  • Oslo’s family-friendly surroundings with their rich opportunities for culture and outdoor activities
  • Salary in position as PhD Research Fellow, position code 1017 in salary range NOK from 550 800 - 595 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund 

We need different perspectives in our work

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues, could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps (Norwegian), we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports. More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here. 

We hope you will apply for the position with us.


How to apply

The application must include:

  • Cover letter (including statement of motivation summarizing prior scientific work) + 1-2 pages on research interests and vision for PhD work
  • CV (summarizing education, positions, pedagogical experience, administrative experience and other qualifying activity)
  • Transcripts of records, copies of the original Bachelor’s and Master’s degree diploma (see below)
  • A complete list of publications and academic works that the applicant wishes to be considered by the evaluation committee
  • Master's thesis. If your thesis has not yet been completed, upload a draft version.
  • Documentation of English proficiency The appointed candidate cannot start in the position until approved documentation of ENglish language proficiency has been submitted

title: Can you combine structured project delivery with a practical understanding of manufacturing and factory operations?
description:
Bergen Engines is entering an important phase of factory development and production ramp-up. To support this, we are strengthening the Special Projects team with one to two Project Managers who can lead cross-functional initiatives and help turn our operational ambitions into practical, executable projects. Reporting to the Head of Special Projects, you will work closely with Manufacturing, Assembly, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, HSE, Facilities and Finance. The project portfolio is expected to include assembly-capacity and ramp-up initiatives, factory layout and material-flow improvements, tooling and facility investments, CAPEX projects and other operational-improvement activities required to increase manufacturing capability towards 2028.     Your key responsibilities
  • Define project scope, objectives, deliverables and success criteria.
  • Develop and maintain credible project plans covering milestones, resources, costs and dependencies.
  • Coordinate cross-functional project teams and ensure clear ownership of actions.
  • Identify and manage project risks, issues, changes and key decisions.
  • Maintain accurate forecasts and escalate constraints or decisions early.
  • Support business cases, investment requests and CAPEX governance where applicable.
  • Work directly with factory teams to understand constraints and implement practical solutions.
  • Drive projects relating to capacity, throughput, assembly flow, material readiness, layout, tooling and process improvement.
  • Provide concise and transparent progress reporting to project sponsors and relevant governance forums.
  • Ensure that projects are delivered safely, on time, within approved cost and with measurable operational benefits.
  • Coordinate effective handover of completed projects into the responsible operational organisation.
Who are we looking for?  We are looking for people who combine structured project delivery with a practical understanding of manufacturing and factory operations. You may already work as a Project Manager, or you may have led substantial projects or workstreams within Manufacturing, Assembly, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Facilities or another relevant area.   Your qualifications: 
  • Education within technical fields and knowledge of manufacturing. If you have particularly long and relevant experience the education requirement may be disregarded. 
  • 8-10 years of experience from related role.
  • Experience from planning and delivering cross-functional projects or significant work packages.
  • A good understanding of complex engineering or manufacturing environments.
  • The ability to convert broad objectives into clear actions, milestones and accountabilities.
  • A practical and visible approach, including working directly with teams on the factory floor.
  • Commercial awareness and an understanding of project costs, benefits and priorities.
  • A strong commitment to safety, quality and sustainable operational improvement.
  • Clear written and verbal communication.
  • Fluent skills in both writing and orally in English and preferably also in Norwegian.
Knowledge of Bergen Engines’ products, manufacturing processes, assembly operations and internal systems will be an advantage. A formal project-management or relevant technical qualification is beneficial, but a demonstrated record of successful delivery is equally important.   Your personal characteristics
  • Ability to work independently towards goals. 
  • A good team player. 
  • Good cooperative and communicative skills. 
  • Structured and analytical. 
  • Curious and outgoing, not afraid to ask questions and suggest improvements. 
  • The confidence to challenge constructively, resolve obstacles and escalate decisions when necessary.
  • Strong coordination and stakeholder-management skills.
 

Why choose Bergen Engines?

For more than 80 years, Bergen Engines has delivered world-class power and propulsion systems to customers around the globe. Today, we're playing a key role in the maritime industry through innovative and efficient engine technology.

From our headquarters in Bergen, Norway, we work closely with customers worldwide, combining Norwegian engineering expertise with international reach. As part of the Langley Holdings Power Solutions Division, we're investing in growth, new markets, and the people who will help drive our future success.

These positions offer an opportunity to:
  • Contribute directly to Bergen Engines’ future manufacturing capability.
  • Lead visible projects with tangible operational impact.
  • Work across multiple functions and broaden your business experience.
  • Help shape how strategic factory projects are planned, governed and delivered.
  • Develop further within project management and operational leadership.

 

What we offer:

  • At Bergen Engines, you'll have the opportunity to work with advanced technology, international customers and colleagues who are passionate about what they do.
  • Meaningful work that contributes to a more sustainable future.
  • An international environment with exciting growth opportunities.
  • Professional and personal development in a technology-driven company.
  • Competitive salary and company-wide bonus scheme.
  • Flexible working hours and strong work-life balance.
  • Excellent pension and insurance arrangements.
  • Company cabin at Kvamskogen and employee discount programs.
  • Active sports clubs and social activities.
  • Occupational health services.
  • A highly skilled team that supports and challenges each other.

 

Are you ready to join our team?

At Bergen Engines, you'll join one of Norway's leading industrial technology companies and help deliver the power solutions that keep the world moving.

Work location is our headquarters and production facility at Hordvikneset, approximately 20 km north of Bergen city centre.

The position reports to Head of Special Projects- Nanda Kishore. 

For questions please contact: Nanda per mobile +4748286461 or e-mail nanda.kishore@bergenengines.com

Application deadline: 20.09.2026. Applications will be reviewed continuously.


Bergen Engines bygger og utvikler medium speed-motorer til landbaserte anlegg og til applikasjoner i den maritime næringen. title: PhD Candidate in AI-Assisted Software and Systems Engineering
description:
This is NTNU

NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 9,000 employees and 43,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You will find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.

   

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_KHQjc4ndas&t=41sAbout the position

Are you motivated to take a step towards a doctorate and open up exciting career opportunities? As a PhD candidate with us, you will work to achieve your doctorate, and at the same time gain valuable experience that qualifies you for a further career in higher education and research, in and outside academia. 

The Software Engineering group conducts research in a wide range of topics related to design, development, verification, and operation of complex software systems, including emerging technologies and their relation to Software Engineering. You will join a diverse research environment and an exciting Doctoral Programme.

Your immediate leader will be the Leader of the Software Engineering unit.


About the project

Software is today prominent in many critical systems and infrastructures, such as power distribution systems, railway infrastructure, or flight control systems. These systems are subject to complex development and verification processes, including certification and audits, and in general different activities that span the Software Engineering and the Systems Engineering disciplines.

Generative AI and AI agents are rapidly changing how software-based systems are being designed, developed, and evaluated. While AI agents have become common in certain Software Engineering tasks, such as programming, documentation, and vulnerability detection, their adoption for other tasks such as software architecture design, or safety and hazard analysis, is still limited. 

The objective of this position is to investigate and evaluate solutions for software engineering and systems engineering tasks in critical systems and infrastructures. Within this context, the project can be tailored to the interests and background of the successful candidate.


Duties of the position
  • Complete the doctoral education until obtaining a doctorate
  • Carry out research of good quality within the framework described above
  • Author academic publications and popular science dissemination material
  • Participate in the Software Engineering research group
  • Participate in international activities such as conferences and/or research stays at foreign educational institutions
  • Support to education activities in courses within the Software Engineering area
  • Other career-promoting work, such as learning grant preparation fundamentals

Be prepared for changes to your work duties after employment.


Required selection criteria
  • You must meet the requirements for admission to the Doctoral Programme in Computer Science, see Section 6-1 of the PhD regulations for more information.
  • You must have a relevant Master's degree in Computer Science or equivalent. Your degree must include a major independent project (minimum 30 ECTS) equivalent to a master’s thesis.
  • Master students can apply, but the master's degree must be obtained and documented before starting the position and no later than 30.10.2026.
  • You must have a strong and relevant academic background from your previous studies and have an average grade from your Master's degree study, or equivalent education, which is equal to B or better compared to NTNU's grading scale. If you do not have letter grades from previous studies, you must have an equally good academic foundation. If you have a weaker academic background, you may be considered if you can document that you are exceptionally suited for a PhD education, for example through relevant work experience and/or peer-reviewed academic works.
  • Good programming skills.
  • Good oral and written presentation skills in English.
     

The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions for general criteria for the position.


Preferred selection criteria

The following characteristics will be considered an advantage during the selection process:

  • Good understanding of Software Engineering or Systems Engineering fundamentals
  • Experience with modeling of software and/or system architecture
  • Experience with agentic frameworks (e.g., LangChain, Microsoft Agent Framework)
  • Good knowledge of AI concepts, particularly Generative AI
  • Knowledge of aspects related to critical systems and infrastructures

Personal characteristics

To complete a doctoral degree (PhD), it is important that you are able to: 

  • Work in a structured way, set goals and make plans to achieve them
  • Present and discuss your research with other professionals
  • Work constructively under pressure or in the face of adversity 
  • Be good at anticipating problems and identifying logical solutions as well as contradictions and inconsistencies  
  • Be flexible and open to adjusting the plan for the project as needed
     

Emphasis will be placed on personal qualities.


We offer

.

  • An exciting job with an important mission in society
  • Developing tasks in a strong and international professional environment
  • Career guidance and follow-up during the PhD period
  • Open and inclusive working environment with committed colleagues
  • Working capital that can be used to implement the project
  • Mentor programme as a new employee at NTNU
  • Favorable terms as a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK)
  • Free Norwegian language training at a basic level (A2)

As a PhD Candidate at NTNU, you will have access to employee benefits.


Diversity

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals. 

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education. 

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.

At NTNU we want to increase the proportion of women in scientific positions. We have a number of measures to promote equality. 


Salary and conditions

In the position of PhD Candidate, code 1017, your gross salary will normally be NOK 580 000,-per annum depending on qualifications and seniority. A 2% statutory contribution to the State Pension Fund is deducted from the salary. 

The employment period is 3 years for the doctoral work in addition to 1 year of career promotion work.

For employment as a PhD Candidate, it is a prerequisite that you gain admission to the PhD programme in Computer Science within three months of your employment contract start date, and that you participate in an organized doctoral programme throughout the period of employment.

As an employee at NTNU, it is important that you keep yourself up to date with academic and organizational changes and adapt to them.

For the necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services). Candidates who, after assessment of the application and attachments, are considered to be in conflict with the criteria in the latter act, will not be able to be employed.


About the application

The attachments (including a description of your scientific work) must accompany the application as these documents form the basis of the application assessment. The documents must be in English.

Please note: the application will only be assessed on the basis of the information we have received by the application deadline. Therefore, make sure that your application clearly shows how your skills and experience meet the criteria described above. The application and all attachments must be sent electronically via Jobbnorge.no. If you are invited to an interview, you must bring certified copies of certificates and diplomas upon request.

The application must include:

  • Transcripts and diplomas for Bachelor's and Master's degrees.
  • CV.
  • Copy of Master's thesis. If you have recently submitted your Master's thesis, you can attach a draft of the thesis. Documentation of a completed Master's degree must be presented before taking up the position.
  • Project outline containing your own research proposal within the topics of this position, including a description of research questions, methodological design for the project and progress plan (maximum 1500 words/4 pages).
  • Short motivation letter (cover letter) (maximum 400 words/1 page).
  • Scientific publications if you have, or other relevant work that fits the position topics.
  • Names and contact information of three references.
     

If all, or parts, of your education has been taken abroad, we also ask you to attach documentation of the scope and quality of your entire education, both Bachelor's and Master's education, in addition to other higher education. If your institution uses “diploma supplement” (normal for most European institutions), you must attach this. A description of the documentation required can also be found here. If you already have a statement from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir), please attach this as well.

Joint work will be considered. If it is difficult to identify your contribution to joint work, you must attach a brief description of your participation.

When assessing the best qualified, we emphasize necessary qualifications such as education, experience and personal suitability. Motivation for the position, ambitions, and potential for research will also count when assessing the candidates.

NTNU recognizes a wide range of academic contributions and has committed itself to The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment and CoARA (responsible assessment of research and recognition of a greater breadth of academic contributions in accordance with NTNU's social mission).


General information

A public list of applicants with name, age, job title and municipality of residence is prepared after the application deadline. If you wish to be exempt from entry on the public applicant list, this must be justified. Assessment will be made in accordance with current legislation. You will be notified if the exemption is not granted.

If you think this position looks interesting and in line with your qualifications, you are welcome to apply.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Associate Professor Leonardo Montecchi, +47 734 12 964, leonardo.montecchi@ntnu.no. 

If you have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact our HR hiring team at HR@IDI.ntnu.no.

Application deadline: 08.10.2026
